articles.title: Who are the NBA’s highest-paid players? Stephen Curry leads the way with a record $200 Million
articles.standfirst: The top 10 players will earn an estimated total of $958 million this season, which is an NBA record
articles.summary: The top 10 players will earn an estimated total of $958 million this season, which is an NBA record
articles.body:
The 2026-27 NBA season is officially underway, bringing a surge in financial valuation where every franchise is now worth at least $4 billion .

Leading the league in total valuation are the Golden State Warriors at a towering $13.5 billion , followed by the reigning champion New York Knicks ( $12.6 billion ) and the Los Angeles Lakers ( $12.5 billion ), the latter acquired this past offseason by Josh Kushner and Bob Iger at that historic price tag.

These three iconic brands stand as the only sports franchises in the league valued above the $10 billion threshold , fueled by their massive media markets across San Francisco, New York, and Los Angeles.

Stephen Curry Makes History as NBA's First $200 Million Man

Franchises are not the only ones setting financial records, as the top 10 superstars are projected to collect nearly $1 billion in combined earnings this season.

According to Forbes , Stephen Curry leads the pack with an unprecedented $203.6 million in total earnings, making him the first active NBA player to eclipse the $200 million single-season milestone . Curry commands $62.6 million on the court , the highest single-season playing salary in NBA history, complemented by a staggering $141 million in off-court income .

That off-court record was fueled by his blockbuster 10-year partnership signed with Li-Ning following his departure from Under Armour, shattering the previous off-court record of $100 million .

Trailing Curry in the top three are Rockets' Kevin Durant , who is set to pull in $104.9 million , and Giannis Antetokounmpo , who will haul in $103.5 million following his blockbuster summer trade to the Miami Heat .

LeBron James and Anthony Edwards Round Out the Top Five

Sliding down to the fourth spot is LeBron James , who held the top ranking for 11 consecutive seasons before dropping to second in 2025.

The soon-to-be 42-year-old icon is projected to earn $93.9 million , with the vast majority coming via off-court ventures after signing a veteran-minimum $3.9 million deal with the Philadelphia 76ers in July to chase another title.

Rounding out the elite top five is Minnesota Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards , who is set to earn $87.9 million buoyed by major endorsement deals with Adidas and Sprite.

articles.title: NBA in Mexico? Adam Silver shakes up expansion race with huge Mexico City tease
articles.standfirst: NBA commissioner keeps Mexico City in the conversation as the league weighs its next expansion destinations
articles.summary: NBA commissioner keeps Mexico City in the conversation as the league weighs its next expansion destinations
articles.body:
NBA commissioner Adam Silver has widened the conversation around the league’s future by suggesting Mexico City could eventually join the list of expansion destinations.

While Las Vegas and Seattle remain the leading candidates, his latest comments have put an international market firmly back on the radar.

Speaking on The Pat McAfee Show on Tuesday, Silver stressed that fans shouldn’t expect new teams immediately.

“We're still a few seasons away from actual expansion taking place. We've been public about the fact that we're looking at Las Vegas and Seattle. Maybe down the road there's Mexico City, which is the largest city in North America,” Silver said.

Mexico City adds an international twist to the NBA expansion race

Mexico City’s scale makes it an intriguing prospect. The city itself has more than nine million residents, while its wider metropolitan area is home to roughly 22 million people.

That gives the NBA access to a vast potential audience, including local supporters and a large Mexican-American population across North America.

The league also wouldn’t be starting from scratch. Mexico City hosts NBA regular-season games and is home to the Capitanes, the NBA G League franchise. Those ties offer a foundation for growing the sport and gauging fan interest, although a permanent NBA team would require far more than an established audience.

Arena capacity, ownership financing, travel logistics and the economics of operating a franchise would all need close examination.

A new arena district has reportedly entered discussions around a possible Mexico City proposal, but Silver made clear that the city isn’t an immediate priority.

Las Vegas and Seattle remain at the center of the expansion process. Las Vegas has become a major sports and entertainment hub, with several professional teams and a strong connection to the NBA through its Summer League. Silver also noted that groups are considering ambitious arena plans there.

Seattle, meanwhile, has a long basketball history and an eager fan base still hoping to welcome back the SuperSonics, who relocated to Oklahoma City in 2008.

The city has an established arena, but the league must still assess the financial and ownership details before any decision is made.

The NBA last added a franchise in 2004, when the Charlotte Bobcats joined the league. Expanding again would affect the league in several ways, as owners would have to weigh new revenue opportunities against the financial impact of sharing league income with additional teams.

Mexico City has population, basketball interest and international reach on its side, but Las Vegas and Seattle remain the immediate focus. If the league eventually looks beyond those markets, Mexico’s capital could become a serious contender.

articles.title: Lakers face backlash for moving on from Dalton Knecht despite his better numbers than Bronny James
articles.standfirst: Knecht scored more points in one month during his rookie season than Bronny has in his entire career
articles.summary: Knecht scored more points in one month during his rookie season than Bronny has in his entire career
articles.body:
The 2026-27 NBA season is officially underway, with the Detroit Pistons becoming the first team to claim a 1-0 record after defeating the Boston Celtics 121-113. The Pistons' opening victory was propelled by Cade Cunningham (22 points) , Jalen Duren (22 points) , and Duncan Robinson (21 points) all eclipsing the 20-point mark, while Paul George delivered a strong performance with 38 points, the most points in a Celtics debut .

Meanwhile, two of the league's most valuable and popular franchises, the Golden State Warriors and Los Angeles Lakers , kick off their regular season against each other amidst surrounding questions.

The Warriors, led by Stephen Curry , enter the year following a quiet offseason, made more challenging as Jimmy Butler remains sidelined until 2027 and Kristaps Porzingis has no definitive timetable for return.

For the Lakers, this marks the official beginning of a completely new era without LeBron James on the roster, featuring sweeping personnel changes under the full command of the reigning NBA scoring leader, Luka Doncic .

Lakers Waved Dalton Knecht to Keep Bronny James on Roster

Under new ownership and navigating a drastically overhauled roster, third-year head coach JJ Redick faces the monumental challenge of integrating 8 new players , including key additions Walker Kessler and Quentin Grimes , who are projected to join Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves in the starting unit.

However, recent roster cuts have sparked intense fan backlash after the front office officially waived Dalton Knecht , their 2024 first-round draft pick , to reach the league-mandated 15-player standard contract limit before the deadline.

The move came as a shock to analysts, especially considering Knecht was expected to battle for rotation minutes or develop in the G League alongside Bronny James .

The criticism primarily stems from the stark contrast in career production between the two young guards. Knecht's initial NBA breakthrough came in November 2024 , when he erupted for 37 points and tied an NBA rookie record by sinking nine 3-pointers against the Utah Jazz.

In that single month alone, Knecht accumulated 190 total points , more than Bronny James has scored across his entire professional career ( 184 total points ).

Fans and media pundits alike are questioning why Los Angeles opted to release a proven perimeter shooter while retaining James. Selected 55th overall in the 2024 NBA Draft , Bronny has logged 69 games (starting two) across his first two professional seasons, averaging just 2.7 points per game in limited action.

As Los Angeles shifts its focus to opening night, the decision to part ways with Knecht remains one of the most controversial roster moves heading into the new campaign.

articles.title: LeBron James shows off the patch marking his historic 24th NBA season as he looks to keep his crown in his Sixers debut
articles.standfirst: At 41, LeBron James is beginning a new chapter as he tries to prove he can still compete for another championship
articles.summary: At 41, LeBron James is beginning a new chapter as he tries to prove he can still compete for another championship
articles.body:
LeBron James is used to making headlines with every move he makes. This time, ahead of his season debut with the Philadelphia 76ers, attention is turning to a small detail on his jersey. There’s no need to describe it to understand what it represents: James is about to begin a season no one in NBA history has played before.

Tonight’s game against the New York Knicks will be his first regular-season game with Philadelphia. It’s a high-stakes setting: the Knicks are the defending champions, and the Sixers are opening a new campaign hoping to get back into the title race.

A small detail for a historic season

“King James” is entering his 24th season and extending his own NBA longevity record. He also arrives as the league’s all-time leading scorer, with 43,440 points, and holds the record for most regular-season games played, with 1,622 entering the matchup against New York. The patch on his uniform could go unnoticed during his Sixers debut. It’s small, but its meaning and the story behind it are hard to miss.

LeBron spent eight seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers, from 2018 to 2026. During that time, he led them to the 2020 championship and won Finals MVP. He also became the NBA’s all-time leading scorer while playing in Los Angeles.

Longevity alone doesn’t tell the whole story. In the 2025-26 season, he averaged 20.9 points, 6.1 rebounds and 7.2 assists with the Lakers. In the playoffs, he raised his scoring average to 23.2 points per game across 10 appearances. Those numbers show that his impact is still felt on the court, alongside the records he continues to add to his résumé.

Now with the Sixers , “King James” has another chance to compete for a championship and win the fifth title of his career. Philadelphia has brought him together with stars such as Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown in a bid to return to title contention. The season is just getting started, so it’s too early to make predictions. Still, the team has reason to dream: if it builds chemistry and sustains a high level of play, the goal could be within reach.

The small patch on his jersey is part of a much bigger story: a player who, after more than two decades in the NBA , still finds reasons to enjoy the game and show that every day brings a chance to start again. Tonight against the Knicks, LeBron isn’t just beginning a new chapter with the Sixers. He’s also testing, for another season, how long the reign of “King James” can last.

articles.title: “I’m from Ohio. What the f*ck are you talking about?”: LeBron James’ brutal response to a Knicks fan
articles.standfirst: LeBron James had a heated exchange with a Knicks fan at Madison Square Garden.
articles.summary: LeBron James had a heated exchange with a Knicks fan at Madison Square Garden.
articles.body:
It didn’t take long fo r LeBron James to realize that he is not welcome at Madison Square Garden , despite the fact that the legendary player has never hidden his desire to play for the New York Knicks . During the first game of the season, fans made their feelings clear through chants directed at the new Philadelphia 76ers player, and there was even a verbal exchange with fans in the front row.

And while “The King” is coming off a stint with the Lakers, with whom he won a championship, it is worth remembering that, yes, what he says is true: he does not belong to the West Coast .

LeBron James’ confrontation with a Knicks fan

After hearing “We don’t want you” chants multiple times at MSG, LeBron James was caught on camera telling a fan: “I’m not from the West Coast. I’m from Ohio baby. F–k is you talking about?!”

And he is absolutely right. LeBron has spent most of his career playing in the East, even if Knicks fans don’t like it.

LeBron always wanted to play for the Knicks

LeBron’s desire to wear the Knicks jersey dates back several years. According to Brian Windhorst , Nike even included a clause in his contract that would have given him a significant bonus if New York had selected him in the 2003 NBA Draft .

Over time, LeBron himself acknowledged that he once envisioned his career on basketball’s most iconic stage.

During the Philadelphia 76ers media day, the four-time NBA champion admitted:

“I had visions of playing in [Madison Square] Garden and finishing my career in the Garden. One of the best places I’ve ever played.”

“I think it’s the No. 1 arena in the world, as far as for a basketball player. But after they beat San Antonio, I was like, ‘Hey, I can’t.’ I couldn’t do it. Y’all wouldn’t have let me lay that down, at all,” he added.

After the controversy surrounding his departure from the Cleveland Cavaliers to join the Miami Heat in 2010 , LeBron did not want to go through a similar situation again. And now, after the reaction from Knicks fans, it appears that staying away from New York ended up being the right decision.

articles.title: LeBron James and Savannah open their Los Angeles home for an intimate look at their family life
articles.standfirst: Vogue’s tour reveals the memories behind their most treasured possessions
articles.summary: Vogue’s tour reveals the memories behind their most treasured possessions
articles.body:
L eBron and Savannah James welcomed Vogue into their home for an episode of the magazine’s Objects of Affection series. Among luxury pieces and everyday comforts, they shared stories that connect LeBron’s basketball career with their family’s life together.

The tour begins with a hyperbaric chamber LeBron has kept since his second stint in Cleveland. He uses it to support his recovery and says it’s a place where he can sleep without interruptions. Savannah finds it too small and claustrophobic. Their differing opinions lead to one of the video’s most playful moments.

Championship trophies and family keepsakes anchor the tour

In the living room, LeBron shows off his four NBA championship trophies. Looking at the one from 2012 , he recalls the criticism he faced for his decision to join Miami and how rewarding it felt to win after falling short in his first year. The 2020 title carries a different meaning: won with the Lakers during the pandemic bubble in Orlando, it brought a championship back to Los Angeles.

Savannah shares one of the most personal pieces in the home: a bracelet featuring the heartbeats of their three children, Bronny, Bryce and Zhuri, with LeBron’s initial on the clasp. She says the thoughtful gift made her cry. When she travels, it reminds her that her children are with her even when she’s away from home.

The family is also honored in a custom LeBron James Edition Mercedes-Maybach S 680, one of only two. The children’s birth dates are engraved inside. The second car is being auctioned, with the proceeds going to the LeBron James Family Foundation, which supports children and families in the community.

Other standout items include Jean-Michel Basquiat’s Minor Success , a work LeBron connects to the artist’s signature crown motif; a Louis Vuitton denim jacket; and a Cartier Crash watch Savannah spent six months finding for their anniversary. The couple celebrated 13 years of marriage in September.

Luxury shares space with more casual favorites : a kitchen display of sweets they call “Dessert Row” and a cold plunge LeBron considers one of the best spots in the house, even though Savannah doesn’t share his enthusiasm.

The video offers more than a glimpse inside the home. It shows the memories, jokes and family gestures that give these objects their meaning. Vogue released the tour as LeBron began a new chapter in his career, making his regular-season debut with the Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.title: LeBron James heard “We don’t want you” chants as the Sixers spoiled the Knicks’ championship celebration
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia beat New York 106-100 on the night the Knicks received their championship rings
articles.summary: Philadelphia beat New York 106-100 on the night the Knicks received their championship rings
articles.body:
LeBron James opened his historic 24th NBA season with the Philadelphia 76ers to a hostile welcome at Madison Square Garden. As he stepped to the free-throw line, Knicks fans chanted, “We don’t want you.” James made his first free throw and missed the second as the crowd celebrated.

The taunts had a backstory. James had said he once imagined playing at Madison Square Garde n and finishing his career with the Knicks, but later ruled out that possibility. New York fans brought up those comments on a night when the team received its championship rings and raised a banner celebrating its first title in 53 years.

Maxey led the comeback as LeBron filled the stat sheet

Philadelphia spoiled the defending champions’ celebration with a 106-100 win. The Knicks led 58-54 at halftime, but the Sixers outscored them 29-18 in the third quarter to take control. Tyrese Maxey led all scorers with 28 points, and Jaylen Brown added 19.

In his official Philadelphia debut, LeBron finished with 14 points, nine rebounds and seven assists, along with a steal and a block. He wasn’t the game’s leading scorer, but contributed in several areas as the Sixers opened the season with a statement win.

The chants were not the only tense moment between James and the crowd. During the first half, he had an animated exchange with a courtside fan. NBC Sports described it as a conversation; no physical altercation was reported.

The Sixers’ next game is at home against the Cleveland Cavaliers on Thursday, Oct. 22, at 7 p.m. ET on ESPN. After a boisterous night in New York, James will get his first chance to play in front of Philadelphia fans in the regular season.

articles.title: Aday Mara makes his NBA debut by putting Wembanyama on a poster
articles.standfirst: The Spanish center made the defensive play of the game
articles.summary: The Spanish center made the defensive play of the game
articles.body:
The Western Conference tipped off in the NBA with a rematch of the showdown both teams played in their bid for a spot in the Finals , which ultimately went to San Antonio . This time, the Thunder struck the first blow with their win at the Frost Bank Center.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was once again the leader of a team that keeps its hopes of repeating as champions intact. The Canadian was the barometer of the game with 32 points , especially in the second half, when the game was being decided.

On the other side, Victor Wembanyama 's start to the season faded into a dreadful 1-for-13 shooting, which gave him 12 points and 13 rebounds . But above all, he ended up being on the receiving end of the game's poster play (and surely one of the best of the season), delivered by a Spanish rookie who will never forget his NBA debut.

It didn't take long for the player from Zaragoza to make his debut. With 5:39 left in the first quarter, Mara came on as a substitute for Chet Holmgren , and 36 seconds later he was already on the receiving end of a personal foul by Wemby . Mara missed the first free throw but made the second, his first point in the NBA.

Mara kept producing in his fabulous debut in the best League in the world. With 3:01 left in that first quarter, he grabbed his first rebound, and at 2:28 he recorded his first assist, with Jared McCain as the recipient (21-26). In his second stint back on the court, with 5:22 remaining in the third quarter, he made the first of the three field goals he converted (66-78).

But the play that has already gone around the world came with 4:20 left in the third quarter. Wembanyama was getting ready to finish an alley-oop with a dunk when he ran into Mara , who denied him passage by turning the play into a brutal block. But what was sensational defense of his rim became a fast break for the center, who finished the sequence with a dunk off an alley-oop (70-84). The best calling card for Mara as an NBA player.

"Big Spain," as Kenrich Williams calls him, who in preseason already saw that Mara can make the league’s first or second all-defensive team, finished the game in which he played 12 minutes with 7 points, 3/4 on two-point shots and 1/2 on free throws, two rebounds, one assist and one block . His +/- was +9, but his impact on the game was much greater.

Mara shined in his debut as the Thunder began to build their revenge against the Spurs . They are the two top favorites in the West and their battle has just begun. OKC won the first round and Aday Mara is already known in the NBA.

articles.title: The WNBA rules out Enes Kanter and Royce White, two former NBA players, by defining them as "men"'
articles.standfirst: The WNBA has just taken the first step toward defining what a woman is in sports and acknowledges that identifying as a woman does not alter fundamental human biology
articles.summary: The WNBA has just taken the first step toward defining what a woman is in sports and acknowledges that identifying as a woman does not alter fundamental human biology
articles.body:
Cathy Engelbert , commissioner of the WNBA , informed Republican lawmakers that former NBA players Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White do not meet the requirements to play in the WNBA because "both are men".

Engelbert responded this way to an inquiry from Congress, without providing the definition of "women" that lawmakers had requested.

Regarding your questions about eligibility, only women may play in the WNBA, and the people you mention in your letter are both men

Lawmakers asked how the WNBA defines the term "women" pursuant to Article XIII, Section 1(a), of its collective bargaining agreement, and why the two former NBA players were deemed ineligible.

'"With regard to your questions about eligibility, only women may play in the WNBA, and the people you mention in your letter are both men," Engelbert wrote in her October 16 response.'

Who determines someone's identity? The person themselves, the commissioner, a medical professional, a committee, or a working group? And who determines eligibility to compete in the women's category?

The document was provided to the outlet "OutKick" by the America First Policy Institute (AFPI) , an organization that represents Enes Kanter Freedom.

Engelbert's letter did not announce a new eligibility rule or detail a broader policy governing transgender athletes .

The WNBA cannot clearly define what a woman is

Freedom and White had announced their intention to enter the 2027 WNBA draft, while also stating that they identify as women.

I just want her to respect my identity, because I tell them that I identify as a woman

"Cathy Engelbert cannot clearly define what a woman is, but she is absolutely sure that I am a man. I mean, what sense does that make? Who decides? Who has the authority to determine whether someone is a woman? If the WNBA is still analyzing these questions, how can its commissioner be so sure about my eligibility without explaining the criteria she is applying?" Enes Kanter Freedom told "OutKick".

'When asked whether he believed Engelbert had used the wrong gender when referring to him in her letter to Congress, Freedom responded: "Yes, 100%... I just want her to respect my identity, because I’m telling you that I identify as a woman".'

Enes Kanter Freedom emphasized that "this goes beyond a single basketball player. That is, who determines someone's identity? The person themselves, the commissioner, a medical professional, a committee, or a working group? And who determines eligibility to compete in the women's category? They may be different decisions, but the WNBA must explain where it draws the line".

'Marlin Stutzman: "The WNBA has just taken the first step toward defining what a woman is in sports"'

The letter responded to an inquiry made on September 17 by Indiana Republican Congressman Marlin Stutzman, along with four other House Republicans, regarding eligibility criteria, player safety, and interactions with fans.

"The WNBA has just taken the first step toward defining what a woman is in the realm of sports. By clearly classifying Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White as men, they have acknowledged that identifying as a woman does not alter fundamental human biology," Stutzman said in a statement.

articles.title: Aday Mara: "It makes me laugh because there were people who said I wasn't going to play"
articles.standfirst: The Spaniard, happy, talks about his NBA debut with the Oklahoma City Thunder
articles.summary: The Spaniard, happy, talks about his NBA debut with the Oklahoma City Thunder
articles.body:
The first game in the NBA is unforgettable . That is what is going to happen to Aday Mara , who experienced a moment that only a chosen few can boast of. He is now an NBA player after making his debut with the Oklahoma City Thunder. But what is more, the Spanish player did it in style, with a convincing performance, rising above the pressure of the atmosphere and with a huge block on Wembanyama that has gone around the world. They were 12 minutes that are already history in Spanish basketball.

'At the end of the game, in Mara 's smile, you could see that he was satisfied with his performance and happy about his debut. And he remembered those who predicted that he would not play in the NBA this year: "I’m happy that it’s now official. It amuses me because it seemed like I wasn’t going to play, there were people out there saying I wasn’t going to play , so that’s another thing that has gone well," Mara recalled in statements to Aragón Deporte after the game.'

Mara played 12 minutes, scoring 7 points, as well as grabbing 2 rebounds, dishing out an assist, and making a brutal block on "Wemby": " I felt good playing and I felt that I helped the team , so I'm happy. It was emotional because my teammates gave me the ball, I hadn't thought about it . I'm going to keep that as a very beautiful memory," he said.

'The Spanish giant recalled for Aragon Deporte the play with which he has kicked down the door to the NBA: " The first play I make is like a lob pass , I had thought about making a dunk, but I was looking at what everything was like. I see him there and in the end, since I’ve seen it so many times, you watch him play and more or less you learn how he plays . Either I jumped there earlier, or he was going to dunk, so I gave it a try," he said in reference to the block on Wembanyama in the third quarter of the game.'

'At the end of the game came the most emotional moment for Aday : going over to the stands and celebrating his debut and the victory with his family: "Having my parents here, and with today being my father's birthday, it was really nice that they could be here, celebrate my father's birthday with him and with my mother and that they were able to come watch the game ."'

'Regarding the performance of the player from Aragon, his coach Mark Daigneault was very clear at the end of the game in San Antonio: "He had a great impact . He probably had one of the stretches of the game that was decisive. He did not seem overwhelmed by the atmosphere of the game. It does not surprise me because of his performance in the preseason . I think he has proven to be a highly impactful player. Tonight he did not get many minutes, but his impact was notable I am going to trust him even more after seeing how he performed in a game of such a high level ".'

articles.title: LeBron James' message following the 76ers' first win is a wake-up call to his teammates: “It’s going to take some time”
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia shocked the New York Knicks on opening night
articles.summary: Philadelphia shocked the New York Knicks on opening night
articles.body:
L eBron James urged the Philadelphia 76ers to remain patient despite an impressive 106-100 victory over the New York Knicks , warning that their championship ambitions will require time, chemistry and adjustments after a major offseason rebuild. The 41-year-old began his record 24th NBA season with 14 points, nine rebounds and six assists, helping Philadelphia overcome the reigning champions as Tyrese Maxey led the way with 28 points, while newcomer Jaylen Brown contributed 19 points, eight rebounds and six assists.

“It’s going to take some time,” James said. “It’s just one game, but obviously we can learn from the good things that we did. We’re still new to each other. We will have some bumps in the road at times. “But I mean, I think tonight when we had those bumps in the road, we were able to use what happened previously and then make the adjustment.” The message was a reminder that one encouraging result cannot immediately transform a group of new teammates into a championship contender as James understands the demands of winning at the highest level. Now Philadelphia must now turn its opening-night promise into consistent performances if they hope to beat star names such as Luka Doncic , Nikola Jokic , Victor Wembanyama and Steph Curry over the course of the season.

LeBron believes 76ers championship pedigree could carry team

The victory was significant as Philadelphia toppled the defending champions at Madison Square Garden , however, the opening stages against New York showed that talent alone would not guarantee immediate success. The 76ers struggled to find their rhythm before gradually improving, with their ability to respond to adversity proving decisive in the second half, but a late third-quarter surge changed the momentum. The Knicks threatened to recover, cutting the deficit to one point at 96-95 after Karl-Anthony Towns connected from beyond the arc but Joel Embiid answered with a three-pointer of his own, helping Philadelphia maintain control and secure a statement victory. The 76ers closed the third period with an 11-0 run, capped by Brown 's second consecutive three-pointer at the buzzer, establishing an 83-76 advantage – and LeBron feels the ex- Celtic will be key for the team maintaining their high standards. “He’s just another guy that can hold guys accountable because they understand,” LeBron added. “They see a guy that has gotten to the finish line. “It’s definitely very helpful. These guys that have been here are trying to be able to get to that point, obviously this is a marathon, and we’re not going to do it in day one. “But the experience that we have, the experience that we bring to this ball club, hopefully we can translate it to wins and more.” Brown won the NBA Finals MVP award in 2024 when Boston captured the championship, while James brings four titles and decades of postseason experience, and that kind of pedigree and leadership could prove crucial. Now the 76ers next challenge comes against the Cleveland Cavaliers on October 22, giving James a personal return to the franchise where he began his career in 2003 – famously winning the 2016 NBA Finals against all odds.

The former NBA star insisted the footage was not AI, and his lookalike even appears to match him in height. To complete the joke, Shaq claimed he has been fooling the world for years, revealing that his “twin” is actually the stunt double who helps him film all his commercials.

articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal reveals his “twin brother” and surprises with their incredible resemblance: “I fooled you all these years”
articles.standfirst: Shaq appeared alongside a man practically his same height and introduced him as “Jack O"Neal.” The supposed revelation, however, was just another prank by the NBA legend.
articles.summary: Shaq appeared alongside a man practically his same height and introduced him as “Jack O"Neal.” The supposed revelation, however, was just another prank by the NBA legend.
articles.body:
'Shaquille O"Neal once again showed that his sense of humor remains one of his greatest assets. The NBA legend appeared in a video alongside a massively built man who was practically his same height, whom he introduced to the cameras as his supposed twin brother.'

“America, I can no longer keep the secret. I have a twin brother and his name is Jack O"Neal”, Shaq began by saying with absolute seriousness before calling over his companion.

“Come here, Jack. Step closer so they can see that we’re the same size”, he added as both of them stood in front of the camera.

The alleged twin brother of Shaq

The scene was designed to provoke a second look. At 2.16 meters tall, O"Neal does not usually come across many people capable of standing beside him without being dwarfed. His companion, however, was practically his height, which made the joke even more convincing.

“Don’t tell anyone that I have a twin brother,” Shaq continued between laughs before signing off with an “I love you.”

O"Neal himself capped off the bit by saying he had been “fooling” the public all these years, a reference that fits with the particular relationship he maintains with his image and with publicity.

But there was no family revelation behind the video. The so-called "Jack O"Neal" is not Shaquille O"Neal's twin brother. USA Basketball biographical records indicate that Shaq has three siblings: LaTeefah, Ayesha, and Jamal.

Shaq turns his own image into part of the show

The joke also comes at a time when O"Neal is once again talking about one of the most important facets of his career outside basketball: advertising .

In an interview published this week by Fortune, Shaq reviewed how he built his brand from his early years as a professional and recalled some of the business deals that shaped his career, including those made with Icy Hot, The General, Pepsi, and Reebok.

In fact, O"Neal said in that conversation that he still believes he does not have enough television commercials and was open to continuing to work with brands.

That relationship with advertising helps explain the tone of the video. At 54, Shaq no longer needs to be on a court to turn his enormous personality into entertainment. This time, it was enough to stand next to a supposed twin and let the resemblance do the rest.

For a few seconds, “Jack O"Neal” seemed to really exist. Then it became clear that, as so often with Shaq, the story was simply a well-executed joke.

articles.title: Where to watch LA Lakers vs Golden State Warriors and what time is tonight's game?
articles.standfirst: Lakers and Warriors light up Crypto.com Arena: Dončić versus Curry in a Western Conference classic
articles.summary: Lakers and Warriors light up Crypto.com Arena: Dončić versus Curry in a Western Conference classic
articles.body:
Few matchups kick off a regular-season week with the shine this one has. The Los Angeles Lakers host the Golden State Warriors at the Crypto.com Arena, a showdown that brings together two franchises with winning DNA, two rosters packed with marquee names, and a rivalry that always raises the temperature in Southern California.

Here we tell you everything: the schedule, where to watch it in the United States, and the keys that will decide the game.

Lakers vs Warriors: Time and where to watch it

The matchup is scheduled for the night of this Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 10:00 p.m. Eastern Time (9:00 p.m. Central Time and 7:00 p.m. Pacific Time). The venue will be the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angele s, an arena with a capacity of around 20,000 fans that promises a vibrant sellout for one of the most attractive visits on the schedule.

In the United States, the broadcast is handled by the NBA’s television partners, but you can watch the Lakers vs. Warriors game live on ESPN. For those who follow the league outside the country and those who prefer to watch it via streaming, NBA League Pass offers the game online worldwide.

How do the LA Lakers vs Golden State Warriors arrive for today's game?

Both teams arrive without any games played in the season standings, so this matchup serves as a true statement of intent. The Lakers appear in 14th place in the overall standings and the Warriors in 10th, but those numbers are merely a starting point: what is at stake is the emotional tone for starting the campaign on the right foot in the always fierce Western Conference.

The sportsbook clearly tips the scales toward the home team: the Lakers open as favorites with an implied probability of 66.3%, compared to the Warriors’ 33.7%. The total points line (over/under) sits around 234 points, a sign that the market anticipates a high-tempo game with plenty of scoring.

In the point spread, the Lakers are carrying a line around -6 / -6.5, reflecting the advantage of playing at home and the depth of the Los Angeles roster.

The Lakers' project revolves around Luka Dončić, the 27-year-old Slovenian who combines vision, ball-handling, and elite scoring ability. Alongside him, the backcourt has experience with Austin Reaves and the explosive Collin Sexton, while Quentin Grimes provides shooting and perimeter defense.

In theory, the defensive-minded signing of Walker Kessler and the championship experience of Kevon Looney give Los Angeles presence in the paint and rim protection. The bench is rounded out with versatile pieces like Jake LaRavia, Jarred Vanderbilt, and Matisse Thybulle, a defensive specialist who can make life difficult for opposing shooters. Also on the roster is 22-year-old Bronny James, looking for minutes in the rotation.

For their part, Golden State continues building around its legend: Stephen Curry, at 38 years old, remains the offensive focal point and the league's most feared trigger man from beyond the arc.

The roster is loaded with veteran experience and talent: 37-year-old Jimmy Butler brings toughness, scoring in key moments, and leadership; Draymond Green remains the defensive brain and the glue of the team; and Latvian Kristaps Porziņģis adds height, blocks, and an outside shooting threat from the center position.

The roster is rounded out by the experienced 40-year-old Al Horford, along with rising youngsters like Brandin Podziemski and Moses Moody, with Georges Niang and Gary Payton II strengthening the rotation.

What is the forecast for the game between the Lakers vs Warriors?

With the advantage of playing at home, the status of favorites set by the market, and a roster balanced between offensive talent and defensive solidity, the Lakers have the arguments to prevail.

That said, the Warriors' experience and firepower—with Curry capable of turning a score around in minutes—guarantee that it will not be a walk in the park. The outlook points to a high-scoring game, in line with the total near 234 points: a narrow Lakers victory, in an outcome that could very well be decided in the final quarter.

articles.title: The “aggressive and inappropriate” messages from Tyler Herro allegedly received by Katya Henry, the mother of his child
articles.standfirst: Bucks guard's former partner is seeking court intervention over their increasingly difficult custody discussions
articles.summary: Bucks guard's former partner is seeking court intervention over their increasingly difficult custody discussions
articles.body:
A move to the Milwaukee Bucks was supposed to offer Tyler Herro a fresh start in his NBA career, but the former Miami Heat guard is facing renewed scrutiny over a contentious custody dispute with his former partner, Katya Henry .

Henry has filed court documents alleging that Herro sends aggressive and inappropriate messages when the former couple attempts to discuss arrangements involving their two young children.

According to TMZ, which obtained the filing, Henry wants their communication restricted to a court-approved parenting application rather than continuing through direct text messages or family members.

The disagreement comes as Herro prepares for his first season in Milwaukee following a June trade that has placed greater geographical distance between him and his children.

Henry claims that Herro has insisted discussions involving their children should take place through his mother, rather than directly between the parents.

She described that approach in the filing as an "unreasonable and irresponsible position," arguing that it creates unnecessary complications when important parenting decisions need to be made.

According to Henry , attempts to communicate with Herro have frequently produced responses delivered in an "aggressive, inappropriate and emotionally charged manner."

She also alleges that certain text messages violated an existing court order requiring respectful exchanges between the former couple.

The messages were "incredibly disrespectful and far from courteous or formal," Henry claimed in documents cited by TMZ.

Her latest request seeks to establish clearer boundaries by requiring both parents to use an approved messaging platform for discussions about their children.

Bucks trade complicates parenting arrangements

Herro and Henry share two children, daughter Zya, born in September 2021, and son Harlem, born in January 2023.

Following their separation in early 2025, Henry says she assumed most of the responsibility for the children's day-to-day care while remaining in Miami.

The situation became more complicated when Herro moved to Milwaukee, creating a significant distance between the parents.

Henry alleges that the NBA guard has been "suddenly requesting increased contact and access that can only be accomplished by lengthy air travel involving several moving parts."

She previously sought primary custody and requested safeguards around Herro 's parenting time, although the Bucks player has rejected the suggestion that restrictions are necessary.

Herro embraces fresh start amid custody dispute

While the legal disagreement continues, Herro has spoken positively about returning to his home state of Wisconsin.

"I was kind of pushing for [the trade]. I wanted to come home, have a fresh start. I'm glad it happened, honestly," Herro told SiriusXM.

He also welcomed the opportunity to work with a different coaching staff and embrace the culture developing within the Milwaukee organization.

"Really, everyone in the building is kind of new, and we're all just, you know, embracing this new culture that we're implementing," he said.

The Bucks begin their regular season against the Washington Wizards on October 21, marking the beginning of Herro's latest professional chapter.

However, away from basketball, the unresolved custody proceedings continue to place attention on how Herro and Henry will manage their responsibilities as parents while living in different cities.

articles.title: Vanessa Bryant reveals sign from Kobe before daughter Natalia's Victoria's Secret debut
articles.standfirst: The Bryant Family was shining once again during the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, thanks to Natalia's appearance.
articles.summary: The Bryant Family was shining once again during the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, thanks to Natalia's appearance.
articles.body:
It has now been nearly seven years since Kobe Bryant 's untimely passing, but he continues to live in the hearts of many - as does Gianna Bryant . His name frequently comes up in basketball dates, and his " Mamba Mentality " remains a theme for many athletes around the world.

Nowhere does he stay closer than the hearts of his immediate family. He was survived by wife Vanessa Bryant and two of their daughters, Natalia , Bianka , and Capri . Time doesn't heal all wounds, but the four of them have helped each other through the toughest of times. And now, Natalia is truly shining .

Natalia Bryant debuted at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in 2026

The 23-year-old has turned into a notorious model , and recently got her biggest gig. Bryant took part in the iconic Victoria's Secret Fashion Show for the very first time, sporting a pink-themed outfit that went viral on social media. Before it happened, Vanessa revealed that Kobe and Gianna were with them in spirit .

On the night of the VS Fashion Show, Vanessa posted on her Instagram story a "sign" she received from Kobe and Gianna: " Right before I exited the car, Moonlight Sonata started playing. Always with us. Kobe & Gigi. Sweet Signs. "

Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata played a very special role in Vanessa's relationship with Kobe. Kobe learned to play the song on piano entirely by ear, without any type of lesson. It was a romantic gift of sorts for Vanessa. The song was later played by Alicia Keys at Kobe and Gianna Bryant's memorial service in February of 2020.

articles.title: LeBron James loses his cool as Knicks fans get under his skin in heated courtside clash
articles.summary: LeBron James had a heated exchange with Knicks fans during his Philadelphia 76ers debut at Madison Square Garden. The 41-year-old responded to a heckler who appeared to question his toughness, firing back that he was from Ohio, not the West Coast. The confrontation caught the attention of the NBC broadcast, with Knicks superfan Spike Lee stepping in to help defuse the situation. Despite the hostile reception, James and the 76ers spoiled New York’s championship celebration with a 106-100 season-opening win. James finished with 14 points, nine rebounds and seven assists.

articles.title: De'Aaron Fox mocks Chet Holmgren after heated on-court fight adding fuel to Spurs-Thunder rivalry
articles.standfirst: A rematch on opening night of last season's Western Conference Finals turned into a feisty contest.
articles.summary: A rematch on opening night of last season's Western Conference Finals turned into a feisty contest.
articles.body:
The NBA is well and truly back. Most eyes were on the new-look Philadelphia 76ers , with LeBron James , taking on the defending NBA champion New York Knicks . The Sixers got off on the right foot, beating the champs at Madison Square Garden .

Elsewhere, the Detroit Pistons defeated the Boston Celtics . But it was the game between the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs that provided the highlight of the night. In a rematch of last season's Western Conference Finals , some bad blood clearly spilled over from that series.

During the second quarter, De'Aaron Fox was being posted up by Chet Holmgren in the paint. Knowing that he was in a mismatch, Fox decided to foul Holmgren by throwing him down to the floor. Holmgren's Thunder teammates took offense to that, and a scuffle ensued.

De'Aaron Fox on Chet Holmgren scuffle: "I didn't throw him that hard"

Holmgren didn't look all that annoyed by the foul, and Fox himself decided to downplay the situation after the game ended; but in doing so, he threw some shade at Holmgren's physique . Fox basically told Holmgren to hit the weight room, just without actually saying those words.

" Somebody grabs you like that and you go flying on the floor like that, you've got other problems to worry about. I didn't throw him that hard, I promise you ."

Holmgren's lanky frame has been a contentious topic since he entered the league. Fox believes he was either flopping or really needs to get stronger.

articles.title: JJ Redick throws subtle shade at LeBron James while explaining Lakers' new roster outlook
articles.standfirst: The Los Angeles Lakers will have to change many things after James departed for the Philadelphia 76ers.
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers will have to change many things after James departed for the Philadelphia 76ers.
articles.body:
Because of his larger than life aura, the biggest move of the NBA offseason was LeBron James leaving the Los Angeles Lakers to join the Philadelphia 76ers . It was a somewhat expected move given that rumors suggesting his exit from L.A. had been around for a while.

Still, it was still stunning to see James put on a Sixers uniform during opening night on Tuesday. So far, so good for James and the 76ers, as they beat the New York Knicks at MSG in the season opener. The new-look Lakers will get a chance to strut their stuff at home against the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.

When everyone is healthy, the Lakers' roster will look a lot different this season . Walker Kessler was the big addition, but they also added Quentin Grimes , Collin Sexton , Cameron Carr , and more players. Head coach JJ Redick has his work cut out for him while trying to get all of the new pieces and old pieces to gel together.

JJ Redick believes Lakers roster without LeBron James and co. gives him more options

In Redick's viewpoint, though, the new roster without James and other departing players could actually prove to be beneficial . While speaking to ESPN , Redick explained why the Lakers could potentially be better this season than in the past.

I don't want to compare the teams or the rosters, and I really have not thought about last year's team. What excites me about this roster is there are elements of modern basketball that we just haven't been able to do. Even with [Marcus] Smart, Smart at his age, can't pick up full court every single possession. And he was the only person that was even capable of doing that on our team last year to begin with. So just that alone, that's exciting. I think Walker has the potential to be one of the best rim [protection] guys, and when he's played, he's been that for the most part... So, it's more just being excited about this team, than comparing the two teams.

Redick believes his roster last season wasn't very versatile. With players like James, Marcus Smart , Luke Kennard , Rui Hachimura , and DeAndre Ayton gone, it sounds like Redick can do some things he wasn't able to before.

articles.standfirst: The Warriors will open the season on the road against the Lakers and Luka Doncic
articles.summary: The Warriors will open the season on the road against the Lakers and Luka Doncic
articles.body:
The NBA is officially back with the Detroit Pistons , Philadelphia 76ers , and Oklahoma City Thunder earning the first wins of the season over the Boston Celtics , the champions New York Knicks , and runner-ups San San Antonio Spurs respectively.

With 11 more games on the docket today, among the most compelling matchups are the Minnesota Timberwolves vs. Miami Heat and the Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers .

For the Lakers, this marks the official beginning of a completely new era without LeBron James on the roster, featuring sweeping personnel changes under the full command of the reigning NBA scoring leader, Luka Doncic .

For the Warriors and Stephen Curry , the year seems like a long one following a quiet offseason, made more challenging as Jimmy Butler remains sidelined until 2027 and Kristaps Porzingis has no definitive timetable to return as Golden State actively explores potential trade partners.

Warriors Explore Trade Options for Kristaps Porzingis

According to reports from ESPN , the Golden State Warriors are pursuing possible trades for veteran center Kristaps Porzingis as uncertainty surrounding his NBA future continues ahead of their season opener against the Lakers tonight.

According to ESPN, the 31-year-old is considering retirement as he continues to struggle with the condition known as POTS ( postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome ).

Porzingis signed a two-year, $40 million extension last summer, with just $3 million of his salary for next season guaranteed.

The Milwaukee Bucks are among the teams that have been contacted recently by Golden State about a potential Porzingis deal , according to a league source who spoke under condition of anonymity to describe ongoing deliberations.

While the Bucks are not believed to have any interest in Porzingis, it’s as clear a sign as any that the Warriors are searching for a solution to the Porzingis problem.

Since the start of the 2024-25 season , he has played in just 74 games and has played more than 60 games only twice in his career.

For a thin frontcourt roster like the Warriors, a trade appears imminent as they seek essential reinforcements to maximize the remaining years of Stephen Curry's prime.

articles.title: Steph Curry reveals he spent years shooting with a vision-threatening eye disease
articles.standfirst: The greatest shooter in history had difficulty seeing until he was diagnosed in 2018
articles.summary: The greatest shooter in history had difficulty seeing until he was diagnosed in 2018
articles.body:
Did you know that Stephen Curry is the highest earner for the new NBA season with an unprecedented $203.6 million in total earnings , making him the first active NBA player to eclipse the $200 million single-season milestone? Curry commands $62.6 million on the court , the highest single-season playing salary in NBA history, complemented by a staggering $141 million in off-court income led by his new 10-year partnership signed with Li-Ning .

Stephen Curry’s Hidden Vision Battle for Many Seasons

With the season just beginning, we know that across a long 82-game regular season anything can happen, and something that will undoubtedly occur as usual is watching Stephen Curry drain multiple three-pointers per night as the greatest shooter of all time.

But even with his unmatched marksmanship, Curry could have amassed even more records to his name considering it was not until 2018 that he discovered he was playing with a vision-threatening eye disease.

In an interview on The Stephen A. Smith Show ( see video above ), Curry revealed how former Golden State Warriors General Manager Bob Myers first spotted the issue: "Bob told me, Yo, why are you squinting so much during the game? Can you see?' And I didn't. They had me on the camera on the sidelines."

Curry was diagnosed with keratoconus , a progressive condition where the cornea thins and bulges into a cone shape, causing blurred and distorted vision.

Reflecting on his career before getting specialized contact lenses, Curry joked, "The joke is, yeah, this whole time I couldn't see, but thankfully I got some treatments in 2018 when it first happened, and I've been on a good path since."

For this season, Curry stands as the longest-tenured player with a single team across the entire league. However, the Golden State Warriors enter the campaign as betting underdogs, with many analysts projecting them to compete primarily for a Play-In tournament spot.

Golden State opted against major offseason moves, and circumstances grew more challenging after it was announced that Kristaps Porzingis is considering retirement as he continues to battle POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome ).

With star forward Jimmy Butler also sidelined until 2027 , it could be a long, uphill season for Curry and the Warriors as they navigate a fiercely competitive Western Conference.

articles.title: Pure magic in Los Angeles: Luka Doncic hits wild halfcourt shot and taunts Yaxel Lendeborg
articles.standfirst: Luka Doncic is taking over the Lakers and he’s already bringing the fire. A halfcourt bomb, trash talk, and a statement performance against the Warriors.
articles.summary: Luka Doncic is taking over the Lakers and he’s already bringing the fire. A halfcourt bomb, trash talk, and a statement performance against the Warriors.
articles.body:
L uka Doncic has officially embraced his role as the new leader of the Los Angeles Lakers , and with it comes a new chapter in one of the NBA's fiercest rivalries. The Slovenian made that crystal clear against Golden State Warriors newcomer Yaxel Lendeborg, drilling a jaw-dropping halfcourt buzzer-beater before exchanging heated words with the rookie.

Doncic delivered one of the night's signature moments by burying a shot from beyond halfcourt just before the halftime buzzer. As soon as the ball splashed through the net, he turned toward Lendeborg and let him hear it, adding even more fuel to an already fiery matchup.

The tension between the two had been building from the opening tip. Doncic and Lendeborg battled for position, embraced physical play early, and quickly began trading trash talk as their on-court rivalry intensified.

With LeBron James departing in free agency to join the Philadelphia 76ers , Doncic has become the unquestioned face of the Lakers. Head coach JJ Redick has also made it clear that the team's offense now revolves around the five-time All-Star .

Doncic backed up the hype with a dominant first half, pouring in 23 points in just 18 minutes to help Los Angeles build a 66-52 lead at Crypto.com Arena.

He wasn't finished. In the third quarter, Doncic added another highlight to his reel with a dazzling behind-the-back pass that evoked memories of Earvin "Magic" Johnson , setting up a thunderous dunk.

The Lakers are determined to usher in a new era after James' departure. Following a 53-29 campaign last season , all eyes are on Doncic as he looks to establish himself as the franchise's undisputed superstar—and prove he's ready to carry one of basketball's most iconic organizations into its next chapter.

articles.title: 486 Days Later: Tyrese Haliburton Grabs 23 Points in Triumphant Return From Injury
articles.standfirst: Despite the milestone comeback for Indiana's star, the Wizards steal the headlines with a historic milestone
articles.summary: Despite the milestone comeback for Indiana's star, the Wizards steal the headlines with a historic milestone
articles.body:
T yrese Haliburton was one of the standout stars of the day. The Pacers point guard played again 486 days later after the Achilles tendon injury he suffered in the 2025 Finals and posted 23 points and 12 assists in the Indiana Pacers ' 123-120 victory on the New Orleans Pelicans' court .

The point guard got emotional at the end of the game when thinking about his long recovery process. " It means a lot to be back ," he said through tears after the game.

Anthony Davis puts the Wizards above .500

Anthony Davis began his stint with the Washington Wizards with 34 points, 12 rebounds, and 4 assists in the 128-116 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks. With this win, the capital franchise has a winning record (a mere 1-0, mind you) for the first time since November 28, 2022. 1,423 days have passed.

His 34 points tied the highest scoring mark in a debut with Washington, set by Antawn Jamison in 2004. Davis made 11 of his 20 field-goal attempts and 11 of his 14 free throws.

Without AJ Dybantsa, the top overall pick in the latest draft, Trae Young backed up the center with 20 points and 13 assists.

The Bucks were led in scoring by Tyler Herro, with 24 points and 9 assists, and Mexican Jaime Jaquez Jr., with 22 points and 7 rebounds.

Kawhi Leonard returned to Toronto, where he won the 2019 championship, with 23 points and six rebounds in the Raptors' 135-92 victory over the Chicago Bulls.

Leonard shared the scoring lead with Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley, both with 23 points. RJ Barrett contributed 20 in a 43-point victory that marked Brazilian Tiago Splitter's debut as Chicago's coach.

Jordi Fernández starts with a loss

The Brooklyn Nets, coached by Spaniard Jordi Fernández, also lost, in their case at home, 110-103 to the Charlotte Hornets.

Grayson Allen led Charlotte with 21 points and 5 three-pointers, Naz Reid added 20 points, 11 rebounds and 7 assists, and Dennis Schroder contributed 19 points.

Brooklyn couldn't capitalize on Julius Randle's 33 points, 8 rebounds, and 7 assists.

articles.title: Luka Doncic takes the mic and signals a new era for the Lakers
articles.summary: At center court, in front of Lakers fans, Luka Doncic picked up the microphone before the team’s season opener. His message was brief, but it set the tone for a new chapter in Los Angeles.
articles.body: At center court, in front of Lakers fans, Luka Doncic picked up the microphone before the team’s season opener. His message was brief, but it set the tone for a new chapter in Los Angeles. “Hello, Laker Nation. Thank you for supporting us. It’s the start of something new. It’s going to be a special season, so thank you for your support,” Doncic said. The moment carried extra meaning with LeBron James no longer on the team. Doncic was the one who addressed the fans and spoke for the Lakers as they began a new season. That doesn’t mean he can replace what LeBron meant to the franchise, but it showed that Doncic is stepping into a public leadership role. Now he has to make that role his own on the court. The speech was the first gesture; the season opener against Golden State was his first chance to show he could lead the Lakers through the season.

articles.title: Luka Doncic takes the mic after LeBron’s exit and leads Lakers past Warriors
articles.standfirst: Before the season opener, Doncic addressed the Los Angeles crowd, just as LeBron James once did
articles.summary: Before the season opener, Doncic addressed the Los Angeles crowd, just as LeBron James once did
articles.body:
L uka Doncic opened the Lakers’ season with a moment LeBron James might once have owned : he took the microphone at center court and addressed the crowd. “It’s the start of something new. It’s going to be a special season,” Doncic said. With LeBron now on the Philadelphia 76ers, the moment presented Doncic as the public face of a new chapter in Los Angeles.

It wasn’t a replacement for LeBron, whose place in Lakers history is unique . It was a sign that Doncic is beginning to take on the team’s public-facing leadership role. He will have to earn that standing game by game, and he made a strong first case that night: the Lakers beat the Golden State Warriors 127-105 in the season opener.

Doncic backs up his message with a statement win

Doncic led the Lakers with 28 points, eight rebounds and seven assists. He scored 23 points before halftime and capped the first half with a shot from near half court. Austin Reaves added 23 points, while Walker Kessler scored 26 in his Los Angeles debut.

Slovenian star Luka Doncic led the Lakers in scoring as Los Angeles pulled away in the third quarter, despite Stephen Curry’s efforts to keep the Warriors within reach.

Doncic’s uniform carried personal touches, too: a patch recognizing his selection to the All-NBA First Team; four beads on the laces of each shoe, including two hearts and the letters “G” and “O” in honor of his daughters ; and a purple wristband with Jumpman and Luka logos.

Those details accompanied a performance in which he led the team on the court and spoke to its fans before the game.

The game also featured a heated exchange with Golden State rookie Yaxel Lendeborg, who guarded Doncic. The two traded words in the first half, and Lendeborg received a technical foul.

The opener offered both a promise and an early glimpse of Luka Doncic’s new role. The Lakers won convincingly, and he led their offense. Taking on the leadership LeBron left behind will be a season-long challenge. The microphone was the first gesture; keeping the team at that level will be the real test.

articles.title: Luka Doncic freezes up during postgame interview with Malika Andrews and fans wonder about a romance
articles.standfirst: Doncic got his season started in a big way, with a 28/8/7 performance in a win over the Golden State Warriors.
articles.summary: Doncic got his season started in a big way, with a 28/8/7 performance in a win over the Golden State Warriors.
articles.body:
On the second night of this season's NBA action, all eyes were on the post- LeBron James Los Angeles Lakers . With The King out of the picture, it was expected that Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves would carry the offensive load, with new acquisition Walker Kessler playing a major role.

That's exactly what transpired against the Golden State Warriors , as all three players scored 23+ points and were the main contributors in the Lakers' 127-105 win over the Warriors. Doncic, of course, is truly the main guy. He led the team in scoring while pitching in with eight rebounds and seven assists . As the face of the franchise, he was the designated player to speak during the postgame interview.

Luka Doncic remains the No. 1 guy for the Los Angeles Lakers following LeBron James' departure

That interview ended up going viral on social media, thanks to ESPN's Malika Andrews . The famous NBA journalist has garnered a strong following in the basketball community due to her in-depth knowledge of the sport combined with her good looks and humor . While interviewing Doncic, fans noticed the player looked a little bit flustered by Andrews' presence .

Some fans believe Doncic got "stuck" and froze up while being interviewed. They're trying to cook up a romance for the newly single Doncic, who ended his engagement to Anamaria Goltes in March of this year. There's only one problem with the fans' theory: Andrews is married to Dave McMenamin , a top-notch NBA reporter for ESPN who has covered the Lakers for many years.

Doncic will have to look elsewhere for a new romance, but ending his engagement earlier this year hasn't seemed to affect his on-court performance in any way - which is great news for the Lakers.

articles.title: Where to watch Philadelphia 76ers vs Cleveland Cavaliers? TV Channel, livestream and start time at the Wells Fargo Center
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia opens the curtain at home with the weight of the favorite
articles.summary: Philadelphia opens the curtain at home with the weight of the favorite
articles.body:
The 2026-27 NBA season kicks off with a high-voltage matchup at the Wells Fargo Center. The Philadelphia 76ers host the Cleveland Cavaliers in a clash featuring veteran stars, young prospects, and the pressure of starting strong.

With both teams still without significant records in the overall standings, every possession on Wednesday night is worth double in terms of confidence and narrative.

Philadelphia 76ers vs Cleveland Cavaliers: Schedule, venue and where to watch live

The game between Philadelphia and Cleveland will be played at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, an arena with a capacity of 20,478 fans. Tip-off is scheduled for Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 7:00 pm ET (6:00 pm CT and 4:00 pm PT).

For audiences in the United States, television coverage of the NBA this season is provided by various networks and streaming services, with the option of streaming via NBA League Pass for those who want to follow every possession from any device.

Specifically for the game between the 76ers and the Cavaliers, you can watch it on:

TV Channel: ESPN and ESPN Deportes (Spanish broadcast)

Streaming Services: YouTube TV, Huly, FUBO and DIRECTV Stream.

The stars of the Philadelphia 76ers

The Sixers' roster is an interesting mix. At point guard is Tyrese Maxey, the 25-year-old shooting guard expected to carry the offensive load and set the team's pace. Alongside him are highly experienced veterans like LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, two forwards capable of turning the tide at any moment of the game.

The team's star player remains Joel Embiid, the 32-year-old center whose presence completely dictates the opposing defense and opens up space for shooters. The shooting guard corps is rounded out by names like Anfernee Simons and the experienced Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, a defensive specialist and outside shooter.

Youth is also present with VJ Edgecombe, a Bahamian shooting guard of just 21 years old, one of the franchise's future bets.

The weapons of the Cleveland Cavaliers

The Cavaliers respond with a commanding backcourt. Donovan Mitchell, the 30-year-old shooting guard, is the team's scoring engine and one of the most feared players in clutch situations. He's joined by James Harden, the 37-year-old veteran point guard whose court vision and ball-handling skills continue to be a nightmare for any defense.

Cleveland's heart, however, beats in its frontcourt. Evan Mobley, a 25-year-old power forward, is a prodigy of defensive versatility, and alongside center Jarrett Allen, 28, he forms an interior wall that protects the rim and dominates the boards.

On the flanks, there are rotation pieces such as the Croatian Mario Hezonja, 31, the forward Peyton Watson, 24, and the shooter Sam Merrill, 30, who provides firepower from the perimeter.

What the betting market and prediction say for the Philadelphia 76ers vs Cleveland Cavaliers

The odds favor the home team. The 76ers have odds of 1.74 and an implied probability of 55.5%, while the Cavaliers are at 2.20, with a 44.5% probability. In the handicap section, Philadelphia is listed as a favorite with a -2.5 point spread (1.93) and even a -1.5 point spread (1.80), indicating a tight margin despite being the favorite.

The total points are hovering around 235: the 235 line pays 1.91 for both the over and under, a clear reflection of how close the match is anticipated by the bookmakers. The nearby lines of 234.5 and 235.5 confirm that this is a game that should have a combined score of around that amount.

Home-court advantage, depth of talent, and market support all point to a Philadelphia 76ers victory, but it will be a close call. Cleveland's frontcourt duo has the firepower to trouble Embiid and keep the game tight until the final stretch. The prediction leans toward a home win by a handful of points, with the combined scoring hovering around 235.

articles.title: Stephen Curry’s impossible shot set the stage, but the Warriors’ push fell short against the Lakers
articles.standfirst: Stephen Curry wowed fans with a signature 30-foot shot, but the Warriors couldn’t keep pace with the Lakers
articles.summary: Stephen Curry wowed fans with a signature 30-foot shot, but the Warriors couldn’t keep pace with the Lakers
articles.body:
S tephen Curry gave fans a taste of his shooting magic before the Warriors’ season opener. In a clip shared by Golden State , he launched a high-arcing shot from 30 feet that dropped through the net. “OMG what a SHOT from 30,” the team wrote.

The shot set an electric tone for the night, but the game ended with the Lakers celebrating a 127-105 win . It was Golden State’s first game of the season and the Lakers’ first since LeBron James left for the Philadelphia 76ers.

Curry started hot, but the Lakers took control

Curry helped keep the game close early. He scored 16 points in the first quarter, which ended with Los Angeles up 34-33. The Lakers then closed the first half with a 17-4 run and took a 66-52 lead into the break.

Curry finished with 23 points, two rebounds and one assist in 21 minutes. He scored 20 points in the first half but managed only three in the third quarter, then sat out the entire fourth. He shot 7-for-15 from the field and made two of his seven three-point attempts.

Doncic led Los Angeles with 28 points, eight rebounds and seven assists. He scored 23 before halftime and hit a shot from near half court at the buzzer. Austin Reaves added 23 points, while Walker Kessler had 26 points and nine rebounds in his Lakers debut, making all 12 of his shots.

The Lakers broke the game open in the third, outscoring Golden State 36-16. They led 102-68 entering the fourth, allowing Doncic to sit out the final quarter of his first game since April.

Curry’s pregame shot was the night’s jaw-dropping highlight before tipoff, but the Warriors couldn’t carry that energy through the game. The Lakers started their post-LeBron season with a dominant win, while Golden State left Los Angeles with an opening-night loss.

articles.title: LeBron James' teammate makes big mistake and apologizes after photobombing his pregame ritual
articles.standfirst: Tyrese Maxey accidentally got in the way of LeBron’s iconic chalk toss, turning the moment into a viral hit
articles.summary: Tyrese Maxey accidentally got in the way of LeBron’s iconic chalk toss, turning the moment into a viral hit
articles.body:
L eBron James may have changed teams, but he has not left his traditions behind . One of the most iconic is his pregame chalk toss, a ritual that fans and cameras look forward to before every game. With phones and photographers pointed in his direction, James was ready for another signature moment, but one of his new teammates accidentally got in the way.

Instead of capturing the perfect shot of LeBron, the cameras caught Tyrese Maxey walking right in front of him . The Philadelphia 76ers guard did not realize the videographer was ready to record the ritual, and his unexpected appearance turned the moment into an unplanned photobomb. What could have been a ruined video ended up being even better than anyone could have planned, quickly making the rounds on social media.

Maxey later took to social media to apologize for what happened, acknowledging that he was the one at fault. The guard also admitted that he still needs some time to get used to LeBron’s iconic pregame routine. His accidental interruption gave fans a different look at a moment they have seen countless times, and the clip quickly went viral.

There appears to be no bad blood between the teammates after the incident. In fact, James has spoken highly of Maxey, describing him as one of the fastest players in the league, whether he has the ball or not. LeBron has also highlighted how Maxey’s speed and ability to keep attacking defenses can be key to the team.

LeBron knows what Maxey brings to the court

James has praised Maxey’s ability to maintain his pace throughout a game, noting that he rarely seems to get tired. He believes the guard’s speed, both with and without the ball, can help the team put constant pressure on opposing defenses.

Maxey may not have looked quite as quick when it came to getting out of the way of LeBron’s cameras, but his mistake delivered another memorable video . What was supposed to be James’ signature pregame moment became a viral clip starring his teammate, who had to own up to the mishap afterward.

articles.title: Yaxel Lendeborg slams Luka Doncic for “whining and complaining” that led to lost respect
articles.standfirst: The Golden State Warriors rookie held nothing back following his matchup with the Los Angeles Lakers superstar.
articles.summary: The Golden State Warriors rookie held nothing back following his matchup with the Los Angeles Lakers superstar.
articles.body:
As the first game of the new NBA season showed, the Golden State Warriors and Los Angeles Lakers appear to be heading in opposite directions. While the Lakers feel that they have an exciting young trio for the present and future, the Warriors are still banking on major contributions from their aging stars mixed with young players who need to develop.

The Lakers ended up winning their matchup 127-105 , with all three of Luka Doncic , Austin Reaves , and Walker Kessler hitting at least 23 points scored. Stephen Curry had solid game with 23 points, but only two other starters reached double-digits: Yaxel Lendeborg and Gui Santos with 12 points each.

Lendeborg didn’t quite have the impact the 11th overall pick himself was expecting, especially since he committed four fouls, but he did a good job when being tasked with defending Doncic 1-on-1. The rookie made sure to let Doncic know that, which resulted in a technical foul for Lendeborg at one point during the game.

Yaxel Lendeborg says he lost all respect for Luka Doncic after playing against him

After the game, Lendeborg went viral on social media for holding nothing back in his postgame press conference. While speaking about guarding Doncic in his NBA debut, Lendeborg lit into the Lakers star and said he “ lost all respect ” for him due to his “ whining and complaining ”.

Yeah, it was interesting. I got to see what the NBA is like, man. Lot of flopping, lot of foul baiting, lot of praying to the ref. Interesting first game for me, for sure. I had a lot of respect for him. You know, just watching. I didn't really watch the NBA much, I just watched highlights. Seeing him, you know, kill people all the time. But then being in there firsthand, just watching all the whining and complaining, I lost all respect, man. Like that was awful. Like me getting frustrated, it's not about the foul being called, it's about him complaining the entire game. And then you get the foul call, congratulations bro. And then you talk to me like you did something great, bro? Come on, dog. That's just weak.

Fans were loving his honesty, in an age where players a lot of times refuse to speak their minds in order to avoid confrontation or controversy. Lendeborg has already won over Warriors fans, and he’s only going to get better on the court from here on out.
