articles.title: The absurd estimated value of New York Knicks' championship rings will blow your mind
articles.standfirst: The extraordinary jewelry features nearly 800 gemstones and a moving miniature Madison Square Garden
articles.summary: The extraordinary jewelry features nearly 800 gemstones and a moving miniature Madison Square Garden
articles.body:
Winning an NBA championship is a priceless achievement, but the New York Knicks have given that expression a new meaning with an extraordinary piece of jewelry celebrating their long-awaited return to the top of basketball.

Players received their championship rings during a ceremony at Madison Square Garden on October 20, marking the franchise's first title since 1973 following its Finals victory over the San Antonio Spurs .

The rings were created by luxury jewelry designer Jason Arasheben , whose company, Jason of Beverly Hills , has produced championship jewelry for several major American sports franchises.

Featuring 22 carats of diamonds and sapphires, more than 180 grams of gold and almost 800 individually mounted stones, the design has attracted attention well beyond basketball.

Although the Knicks haven't disclosed the manufacturing cost, jewelry specialist Neil Dutta believes each ring could carry an extraordinary six-figure valuation.

"I'd estimate the New York Knicks' championship rings could be worth up to $250,000 each," Dutta , managing director of Angelic Diamonds, told the New York Post.

He pointed to the Golden State Warriors ' 2022 championship rings, which reportedly cost approximately $108,000 each to produce, as a useful comparison.

"Given the greater combined gemstone weight and the complexity of the Knicks' design, I think a valuation approaching $250,000 is plausible," Dutta added, "although the quality of the individual stones would ultimately influence that figure."

The estimate reflects the materials and craftsmanship involved rather than a confirmed production cost.

Arasheben declined to provide a specific price when asked about the rings during an appearance on CBS Mornings.

"It's like asking how much the Mona Lisa is. It's priceless," he said.

Knicks ring unlike ordinary championship jewelry

The design's most distinctive feature is a miniature recreation of Madison Square Garden concealed within a movable centerpiece.

Turning the ring raises a detailed representation of the arena's exterior, while the removable section incorporates elements of the building's interior.

Dutta explained that combining moving mechanical components with hundreds of carefully mounted gemstones presents significant manufacturing challenges.

"Every component has to fit precisely, and the settings need to remain secure when the ring is opened and closed," he said.

The jewelry also contains several references to New York's championship run.

A 0.16-carat diamond represents the team's 16-point comeback in the decisive Game 5, while 16 emerald-cut diamonds commemorate its playoff victories.

An engraving reading "Knicks in Five" celebrates the five-game Finals victory over San Antonio.

Fans can purchase commemorative championship rings

Although the player-issued rings are not available for general purchase, Jason of Beverly Hills has created a limited collection for supporters.

The most exclusive fan version costs $19,995, with only 200 individually numbered rings produced.

More affordable commemorative merchandise is also available, including a $299 option made using less expensive materials.

Arasheben explained that the championship ring was intended to capture the franchise's identity rather than simply showcase precious gemstones.

"The ring was designed to capture the team's identity and the defining moments of its title run," he said.

After waiting more than five decades for another championship, the Knicks have commemorated their achievement with a design that reflects both the magnitude of their success and the history of Madison Square Garden.

articles.title: “It's not my job!!!” NBA star LaMelo Ball slammed for refusing to change his baby's diapers
articles.standfirst: The Minnesota guard revealed that girlfriend Ana Montana handles diaper changes, prompting a heated reaction online
articles.summary: The Minnesota guard revealed that girlfriend Ana Montana handles diaper changes, prompting a heated reaction online
articles.body:
A successful opening night with the Minnesota Timberwolves should have given LaMelo Ball plenty to celebrate, but the 25-year-old guard instead found himself at the center of an unexpected controversy over his responsibilities as a father.

Ball scored 21 points and recorded six assists in Minnesota's convincing 131-106 victory over the Miami Heat on Wednesday, delivering an encouraging performance in his first regular-season appearance with the franchise.

However, an interview with veteran ESPN broadcaster Ernie Johnson produced a moment that quickly attracted more attention than his statistics.

Asked whether he changes the diapers of his nine-month-old son, LaOne, Ball explained that the responsibility generally falls to his girlfriend, Ana Montana .

His response prompted immediate surprise from Johnson and subsequently generated criticism among basketball fans discussing the exchange online.

The conversation began when Johnson asked the Timberwolves star about his experiences caring for his young son.

"Nah, my girl do all that," Ball replied, referring to Montana and her role in handling diaper changes.

Johnson appeared unconvinced by the arrangement, suggesting that the quarterback-like playmaker was missing an important part of parenthood.

"Man, you don't know what you're missing," Johnson responded.

Ball then clarified that he had changed diapers before, but maintained that it was not something he considered his regular responsibility: "It's just not my job," he said.

Although the exchange appeared lighthearted, the admission quickly became a talking point, with critics questioning why a routine parenting task should be assigned exclusively to one partner.

NBA fans question Ball's approach to fatherhood

The comments prompted a wider discussion about how parents divide responsibilities while raising young children.

Some social media users criticized Ball 's position, arguing that changing diapers should be a shared responsibility rather than something automatically assigned to a child's mother.

Others pointed out that the brief interview offered little information about the couple's broader parenting arrangements or how they manage their household.

Ball and Montana welcomed their son, LaOne, in January 2026, beginning a new chapter in their relationship.

While the basketball star's remarks made clear that Montana usually handles diaper changes, they didn't establish how the couple divide their other responsibilities.

Montana hasn't publicly addressed the latest discussion surrounding her boyfriend's comments.

articles.title: LeBron James admits the challenge of living far from Savannah: “She has always been my backbone”
articles.standfirst: The Sixers star acknowledges the importance of his wife while they both maintain a life between two coasts, without giving up family support.
articles.summary: The Sixers star acknowledges the importance of his wife while they both maintain a life between two coasts, without giving up family support.
articles.body:
LeBron James acknowledges that one of the challenges of his new chapter in Philadelphia is off the court. While he competes with the 76ers and keeps his residence in New York, Savannah remains in Los Angeles with their daughter Zhuri . The player supports that family arrangement, although he admits that getting used to living away from his wife will not be easy.

“It will be a challenge, without a doubt, because she has always been my backbone,” James said. The phrase highlights the support Savannah represents for him, beyond team changes and the demands of his career.

The family decision LeBron supports from afar

Behind that arrangement between both coasts, there is a specific priority: maintaining Zhuri's school stability. LeBron and Savannah considered that the best thing was for their daughter to continue in Los Angeles, rather than disrupt her education to accompany her father's sports relocation.

Savannah's professional projects also weigh in, as her business activity is linked to California. LeBron explained that he is willing to support whatever his wife and daughter need in order to continue developing. His response thus combines two realities: he acknowledges the difficulty of the distance, but supports the reasons why they remain there.

'The adaptation did not begin with these statements. As MARCA had already reported MARCA , James acknowledged during training camp that being away from his family represented a major change in his routine, although feeling supported by his new teammates was helping him. Living with the Sixers is part of that adjustment process, in addition to his sporting integration. '

Savannah and Zhuri accompanied LeBron at his debut with Philadelphia

Maintaining her residence in Los Angeles also did not prevent Savannah and Zhuri from being present at the start of this adventure. Both went to Madison Square Garden for LeBron’s debut in the regular season with Philadelphia, on October 20, against the New York Knicks.

Zhuri arrived holding her mother's hand and wore her father's Sixers jersey. During the night there was also a gesture between the couple: LeBron approached Savannah to give her a kiss before returning to the court. It was a show of support at a time when they no longer share the same city every day.

articles.title: LeBron responds to Trump for criticizing his behavior during the anthem
articles.standfirst: The Sixers forward gets embroiled in another controversy with the President of the United States
articles.summary: The Sixers forward gets embroiled in another controversy with the President of the United States
articles.body:
'L eBron James and Donald Trump have gotten embroiled in a controversy once again. The President of the United States criticized the attitude of the Sixers player during the performance of the national anthem before the first game of the season at Madison Square Garden against the Knicks, and he has already received his response. "There isn't much news in the office today," the forward quipped about the controversies sparked by the president .'

'Trump said that LeBron should "apologize to all those great warriors and heroes who died for the American flag and for everything our country represents. I said from the beginning that he is useless, a total disgrace" .'

LeBron should apologize to all those great warriors and heroes who died for the American flag and for everything our country represents

Those were the president's words when he saw that the NBA star did not remain still during the playing of the anthem but instead seemed to be practicing a golf swing and a jump shot while most of his teammates did remain motionless. However, Trump's criticism contrasts with his own behavior on some occasions. In 2020, the Miami Herald published a video showing the president waving his hands as if conducting an orchestra while the anthem was playing .

LeBron, active in social causes

It's one more controversy between one of the most famous athletes in the United States and the country's president. LeBron, active in social issues, especially during the "Black Lives Matter" movement , has received a lot of criticism from Trump: "This is a beautiful country and we are never going to let a single person dictate how beautiful and powerful we are" .

"I still know what I’m doing on the court and, obviously, I give everything for basketball, but right now I can have a greater impact off the court than on it . I want to keep inspiring people with the way I play, but there are many more things I can do off the court to help educate people, inspire them, bring them together, and empower them," LeBron said at the time .

articles.title: Draymond Green sparks controversy with bold Luka Doncic prediction
articles.standfirst: "He will never win the NBA MVP"
articles.summary: "He will never win the NBA MVP"
articles.body:
Since his second year in the NBA, Luka Doncic has been among the favorites to win the MVP . He has been selected to the All-NBA First Team six times. He has watched Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Joel Embiid and, on the last two occasions, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander lift the trophy, but he has not achieved it. And, according to Draymond Green, he is not going to achieve it .

The controversial Warriors player has a podcast in which he doesn’t hold back when talking about any issue. This time he gave his opinion on Doncic, of whom he said that "he will never win the MVP. This is the last year he can win it" . It is not a criticism of the Lakers point guard, whose talent and qualities he acknowledges, but rather he is talking about taking things for granted when it comes to some NBA stars.

"If I could average 34 points per game, they would say: "Ah, yes, of course Luka averaged 34 points per game" . We already know that he is supposed to do it, but it would not look the same if someone else did it. It’s as if people got tired of that" , he says. And he also gives as examples Jayson Tatum or the career of LeBron James: "Don’t tell me he should only have four MVP awards" .

In the MVP races Doncic has been part of, he has been hindered by physical problems. In the eight full seasons he has spent in the NBA, only in two of them — his rookie year and 2023-24 — has he managed to reach 70 games . The award is based on statistics, quality, team success, and a consistency that the point guard has almost never enjoyed. Now that he seems to be spending more time taking care of his body, he could have a better chance .

Victories have not gone his way either. While with the Mavericks, his high point was 52 in a regular season . He led the team to one NBA Finals and another Conference Finals. In his first full year with the Lakers, last season, the team reached 53 , although he had to share leadership with LeBron James and was limited to just 64 games. Shai, Jokic and Victor Wembanyama finished ahead of him in the voting . This campaign, as the team’s main figure in Los Angeles, Doncic will try to prove Green’s prediction wrong .

articles.title: Who is Britt McHenry? A member of Trump's team that threw drink at a fan during Washington Wizards' home opener
articles.standfirst: New footage shows the Trump administration adviser exchanging drinks with spectators before leaving to loud boos
articles.summary: New footage shows the Trump administration adviser exchanging drinks with spectators before leaving to loud boos
articles.body:
A night that should have been about basketball became an uncomfortable return to the headlines for Britt McHenry , the former ESPN reporter who now works as a press adviser in President Donald Trump 's administration.

McHenry , 40, attended Wednesday's Washington Wizards game against the Milwaukee Bucks at Capital One Arena, where an argument with nearby spectators escalated into a drink-throwing confrontation.

Footage obtained by TMZ shows McHenry exchanging words with fans before throwing a beverage toward someone seated behind her, prompting loud boos and demands that she leave the section.

The incident has attracted considerable attention because of McHenry 's government position and her previous career in sports television, although questions remain about what triggered the argument.

What happened to Britt McHenry at Wizards game?

The confrontation unfolded during Washington's 128-116 victory over Milwaukee, with McHenry attending alongside a male companion.

According to TMZ, sources close to McHenry claimed that spectators behind the pair had been making inappropriate comments about Winnie Harlow , the model engaged to Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma .

Kuzma previously played for Washington, giving his appearance against the Wizards additional significance.

Those sources alleged that McHenry challenged the remarks before becoming the target of misogynistic comments herself.

A second video subsequently published by TMZ showed spectators shouting at McHenry while an usher attempted to address the situation.

Someone behind her then appeared to throw a drink in her direction, prompting McHenry to pick up a cup and throw it back toward the crowd.

The footage confirms the exchange of drinks, although the competing explanations surrounding the initial confrontation remain disputed.

Why was Britt McHenry booed and escorted from seat?

As the argument intensified, nearby spectators began chanting for McHenry to leave, with some directing insults toward the former broadcaster.

McHenry eventually made her way through the stands while fans booed and threw rally towels in her direction.

Rather than responding angrily to the reception, she was filmed waving and blowing kisses before another confrontation with arena security personnel.

Although initial reports described McHenry as being escorted out, sources close to her disputed that characterization, claiming she left voluntarily and met her companion afterward.

Who is Britt McHenry and what does she do for President Trump?

McHenry built her reputation as a sports journalist, working for ESPN before leaving the network during its widespread layoffs in 2017.

She later moved into political commentary, appearing on Fox Nation and other conservative media platforms before announcing her appointment as a State Department press adviser in September 2026.

Her latest controversy has also renewed attention on a 2015 incident in which ESPN suspended her after video emerged showing her insulting an employee at a towing company.

McHenry subsequently apologized for that confrontation and later disputed the way the footage had been presented.

The circumstances surrounding Wednesday's altercation remain contested, and no official disciplinary action has been announced in connection with the incident.

Nevertheless, the viral footage has placed McHenry under renewed public scrutiny just weeks after beginning her government role.

articles.title: LeBron James visibly jealous with Savannah James over joking comment about "patting me down"
articles.standfirst: One question changed the conversation
articles.summary: One question changed the conversation
articles.body:
S avannah James was explaining why her worn-in UGG x Palace slides are her favorite travel shoes when she mentioned they’re easy to take off if she gets an extra pat-down at security. LeBron James immediately interrupted with a question: “Who patting you down?”

The exchange took place during a tour of their Los Angeles home for Vogue’s Objects of Affection series, released a few days ago. Savannah said the slides had traveled around the world three times and were comfortable enough to wear on trips. The key detail: they were easy to take off if security needed to pat her down.

Savannah’s travel shoes caught LeBron’s attention

“TSA,” Savannah replied when LeBron asked who was patting her down. She laughed, but LeBron kept the joke going: “Who’s that? I’ve never met him before.”

Savannah continued explaining how easy it was to take off the slides on a plane, where she likes to stretch out and sleep. When LeBron noticed how worn they were, he joked that they needed a new pair. He even asked UGG and Palace to send Savannah two pairs.

LeBron’s move to the Philadelphia 76ers has brought a major change to the family’s routine. He is now based in New York while playing in Philadelphia, but his wife has stayed in Los Angeles with their daughter Zhuri to keep her school life stable.

That means more travel for the family as they adjust to this new chapter. LeBron has called the distance a challenge, saying Savannah has always been “my backbone.”

The Sixers’ next game is Saturday, Oct. 24, against the Milwaukee Bucks at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia. Tipoff is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. ET.

articles.title: The Ultimate Bait and Switch: Knicks scammed employees with cruel promise of championship rings on opening night
articles.standfirst: Assistant coaches reportedly received empty presentation boxes while employees faced an unexpected surprise
articles.summary: Assistant coaches reportedly received empty presentation boxes while employees faced an unexpected surprise
articles.body:
Winning an NBA championship is supposed to create memories that last a lifetime, but several New York Knicks employees have been left with a very different reminder of the franchise's historic success. While players celebrated their 2026 title with elaborate diamond championship rings, staff members reportedly discovered that an apparent offer of their own commemorative jewelry was nothing more than an internal security exercise.

According to The Athletic, Madison Square Garden employees received an email in September inviting them to select personalized championship rings without paying anything. The message appeared to recognize their contribution to the organization's first championship since 1973. Instead, those who followed its instructions reportedly found themselves assigned mandatory cybersecurity training. "Congratulations, your Employee Championship Ring is here," the message began. "MSG is issuing a complimentary employee championship ring. The same jeweler, the same craftsmanship, personalized with your name. No cost to you." Appearing particularly generous given the significance of the franchise's title, employees were invited to choose between designs labeled Championship Gold and Garden Classic before reserving their preferred ring. However, multiple team sources told The Athletic that the message was actually a phishing simulation intended to test whether staff would interact with a suspicious email. Those who clicked the link were reportedly required to complete cybersecurity training rather than receive the promised jewelry as the exercise was linked to security concerns within the organization. Unsurprisingly, its timing created an awkward contrast with the celebrations surrounding the championship.

Knicks assistant coaches receive empty boxes on championship night

The reported frustration extended to the coaching staff during Tuesday's ring ceremony at Madison Square Garden as players and executives received their championship jewelry. Assistant coaches were presented with black boxes similar to those containing the actual rings, however, the assistants' rings were not inside – adding to the controversy on the night. Seven league sources said that the coaches did not receive their rings that evening, with some learning about the delay only hours before the ceremony as their reactions reportedly ranged from annoyance to genuine anger, although they were assured that their rings would arrive later. "We are not disclosing anything about the rings," said MSG Sports spokesperson, declining to explain the situation publicly when asked by The Athletic. Created by jeweler Jason Arasheben , the rings feature approximately 22 carats of diamonds and sapphires, with nearly 800 individual stones and a mechanism revealing a miniature Madison Square Garden . Independent jewelry estimates have placed their potential value as high as $250,000 each, although the actual cost has not been confirmed.

articles.title: ‘The dictator of the NBA’: Enes Kanter Freedom slams LeBron James motivations
articles.standfirst: Freedom claims the Philadelphia 76ers star is only looking after his own interests
articles.summary: Freedom claims the Philadelphia 76ers star is only looking after his own interests
articles.body:
E nes Kanter Freedom has made fresh claims about the NBA 's political culture, alleging former teammate Dennis Schroder questioned LeBron James ' motives for public activism.

Freedom also described feeling ostracized by Boston Celtics teammates after appearing on Fox News in 2021 as the former center's comments come amid his dispute with the WNBA over its gender eligibility policy.

Freedom attempted to attend Game 3 of the WNBA Finals in Atlanta on Wednesday, but says the league tried to move him from his purchased courtside seat to a private luxury suite, citing security concerns.

The disagreement escalated into a confrontation with police outside State Farm Arena , and Freedom ultimately left without taking his seat. It followed his ejection from a Chicago Sky game in August, adding another public flashpoint to his campaign against transgender women competing in the WNBA .

He recalled asking Schroder during their time together in Boston what James was like as a teammate and how he viewed the former Los Angeles Lakers star's advocacy.

According to Freedom , the German guard offered a blunt assessment of James ' public positions.

"He said, 'Whatever is LeBron doing is for LeBron,’” Freedom said. “I was like, enough said. We don't have to say a word anymore. Because I used to respect him a lot, you know, for what he'd done for black community.

“But when one of his former teammates said, you know, all his advocacy is for, is for LeBron, that's where, that's where he lost me. But I mean, everybody knows LeBron James... I call him the dictator of the NBA.

“And I think President Trump said the best. You know, he disrespects our country and disrespects our flag. LeBron James is the reason the NBA is woke still. I promise you, once he retires, NBA is not going to be as woke as now."

Those are Freedom 's characterizations of James and the league; Schroder 's alleged private remarks have not been independently established in the information provided.

Fox News appearance allegedly drew teammate backlash

Freedom also described a divide in how teammates reacted to his television appearances discussing human rights abuses in China as he said a CNN appearance brought praise.

However, going on Fox News to address the same issue prompted criticism from teammates and concern from his coach as Freedom said he argued that appearing on a particular network did not mean endorsing a political party.

Explaining that he wanted his message to reach a broader audience, he recalled the resistance this way.

"In NBA circles, we don't talk about Fox News, we don't watch Fox News,” Freedom added. “And if you do, you will realize that you are going to get cancelled and you're going to get hated on.”

He further claimed some players privately support conservative causes and President Donald Trump but avoid expressing those views publicly because they fear professional and social repercussions.

articles.title: LeBron James' 12-year-old daughter steals the show with a heartwarming birthday moment
articles.standfirst: The moment offered a reminder that family milestones can be just as meaningful as the action on the court
articles.summary: The moment offered a reminder that family milestones can be just as meaningful as the action on the court
articles.body:
Zhuri James celebrated her 12th birthday courtside as she watched her father take on the Cleveland Cavaliers, but a special message on the arena’s giant screen made the night even more memorable. LeBron James’ youngest daughter, Zhuri James, received a birthday surprise in front of a basketball crowd on Thursday night, turning her father’s game into a family celebration.

Zhuri celebrated her 12th birthday on October 22 while attending LeBron’s home debut with the Philadelphia 76ers against the Cleveland Cavaliers. Although she was there to support her father, the young fan ended up getting a moment of her own when a birthday message appeared on the arena’s massive video screen.

The message was simple but memorable

The surprise was captured in a video shared by Savannah James, LeBron’s wife, on her Instagram Stories . The clip showed the birthday greeting displayed prominently on the big screen, giving the youngest member of the James family a special moment in front of the crowd.

The NBA also joined the celebration, sharing a video of Zhuri enjoying the game and acknowledging her birthday on its official Instagram account. “Happy 12th Birthday, Zhuri James! ” the league wrote alongside the video.

In the NBA’s video, Zhuri could be seen sitting among the spectators, smiling and waving toward the camera as the birthday attention came her way. She wore a Philadelphia 76ers jersey over a white, long-sleeved top, paired with denim jeans.

Her cheerful reaction made the clip a feel-good moment for fans who have followed the James family over the years. The birthday greeting also gave the young fan a chance to experience the arena atmosphere from a different perspective. Instead of watching her father command attention on the basketball court, Zhuri briefly became the center of attention herself.

articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal makes bold claim about Cowboys' season then picks dark horse NBA MVP winner
articles.standfirst: Shaq's recent interview with Athlon Sports spanned several intriguing topics.
articles.summary: Shaq's recent interview with Athlon Sports spanned several intriguing topics.
articles.body:
When it comes to sports figures, Shaquille O'Neal has long been one of the most interesting athletes in all of sports ever since he rose through the ranks at LSU in the early 1990s. Since then, he won four NBA Championships, an NBA MVP award, has carved out a prominent analyst role on national TV, and has several business ventures on the side .

Due to his larger-than-life persona, physically and characteristically, people always want to know what Shaq thinks about not only basketball, but everything that's going on in the sports world. In a recent interview with Athlon Sports' Doug Farrar , O'Neal delved deep into several topics, including the Dallas Cowboys , LeBron James , and a surprise pick for NBA MVP.

Shaquille O'Neal says Dallas Cowboys' season isn't done just yet

Shaq revealed that he believes he would have been an NFL player if he didn't choose to go the basketball route. If he did, he likely would have loved to play for the Dallas Cowboys , since they have long been his favorite football team. Even though the team is struggling right now, Shaq isn't giving up hope - something he mentioned following a story about former Cowboys great Emmitt Smith .

" I remember one time, I was walking through the University of Florida, and a guy, a little guy, he had this big crazy cell phone and said, “Hey man, you coming to the game tomorrow?” I was like, “What game?” He’s like, “My name is Emmitt Smith. We’re about to beat the LSU Tigers.” I was like, “Oh, you’re talking crazy.” And that’s when me and Emmitt became friends. And I was already a Cowboys fan. So, a lot of great memories, a lot of favorite players. And yes, I’m still a Cowboys fan. And the season’s not done. "

Shaq picks Anthony Edwards as his NBA MVP selection

Shaq then transitioned into talking about basketball. He was asked specifically about James and what he will bring to the Philadelphia 76ers.

" He adds a lot. He has a lot of knowledge. The ability to still get certain things done. He’s a very unselfish player. [People are] trying to compare him to Kobe and Mike, but he’s a little bit more like Magic with Kobe and Mike’s skills, whenever he decides to. But listen, he’s already broken all the records and set all the records. It’d be nice for him to get another championship. And with this roster, this is a no-excuse roster if everybody’s there. "

O'Neal believes the 76ers, San Antonio Spurs , Oklahoma City Thunder , Cleveland Cavaliers , and Detroit Pistons have the best chances to win it all this season. And his pick for NBA MVP ? Minnesota Timberwolves guard Anthony Edwards .

articles.title: Steph Curry can’t hide his frustration as Warriors suffer crushing home-opener loss
articles.summary: Stephen Curry had plenty of reasons to be frustrated Friday night.
articles.body:
Stephen Curry had plenty of reasons to be frustrated Friday night.

The Golden State Warriors had their home crowd behind them, built a double-digit lead in the fourth quarter and appeared positioned to open their Chase Center schedule with a victory.

Instead, they watched the Memphis Grizzlies rally for a 111-108 win, turning what looked like a promising night into a painful early-season setback.

Curry finished with 24 points, four assists and two rebounds in 30 minutes, leading Golden State’s offense in a back-and-forth contest that came down to the final minute.

But the result, and the Warriors’ inability to protect their advantage, overshadowed his individual production.

articles.title: Steph Curry’s frustrated reaction highlights Warriors’ costly collapse against Memphis at home
articles.standfirst: The defeat was an especially frustrating way to end a game that was within reach
articles.summary: The defeat was an especially frustrating way to end a game that was within reach
articles.body:
S tephen Curry had plenty of reasons to be frustrated Friday night. The Golden State Warriors had their home crowd behind them, built a double-digit lead in the fourth quarter and appeared positioned to open their Chase Center schedule with a victory. Instead, they watched the Memphis Grizzlies rally for a 111-108 win, turning what looked like a promising night into a painful early-season setback.

Curry finished with 24 points, four assists and two rebounds in 30 minutes, leading Golden State’s offense in a back-and-forth contest that came down to the final minute. But the result, and the Warriors’ inability to protect their advantage, overshadowed his individual production.

Curry was visibly annoyed after the defeat, a reaction that reflected the nature of the loss as much as the final score. Golden State had done enough to put itself in position to win, only to surrender control when it mattered most. The collapse was an especially frustrating way to play in front of its home fans.

A promising night turns into a late-game collapse

The Warriors struggled to find their rhythm early, trailing by as many as eight points in the opening quarter. Draymond Green and Gary Payton II helped change the momentum with consecutive three-pointers, sparking a 10-0 run that briefly put Golden State in front.

Memphis responded, however, and the opening period developed into a tightly contested exchange. Brandin Podziemski provided a late spark, recording a steal against former teammate Quinten Post before knocking down a three-pointer. He then drove to the basket for a buzzer-beating layup that gave Golden State a narrow lead.

The teams continued trading advantages into the second quarter, with 12 lead changes occurring during the opening stretch of the game . Memphis eventually found its footing and stretched its lead to 13 points, forcing the Warriors to fight their way back.

Golden State answered with its strongest stretch of the night late in the third quarter. A 19-4 run helped the Warriors reclaim the lead and carry momentum into the final period. For a while, the comeback appeared to have put them in control.

But the fourth quarter brought a dramatic reversal. Golden State's advantage grew to 13 points before Memphis mounted a furious rally, using a 17-2 run to erase the deficit and tie the game in the final minute. The Grizzlies then delivered the decisive baskets and a free throw to secure the three-point victory.

Curry’s frustration reflects a familiar challenge

Curry's 24 points made him Golden State's leading scorer, but the Warriors needed more than individual production to survive Memphis' late surge. The loss highlighted the importance of maintaining composure and execution when opponents make their final push.

Golden State had weathered Memphis' early runs, recovered from a sizable deficit and built a commanding fourth-quarter lead. Yet none of that mattered once the Grizzlies found a way back into the contest. Curry's visible frustration was an understandable response to a game that appeared within reach.

For a veteran who has experienced the highest levels of NBA success, watching a 13-point lead disappear in the closing minutes is precisely the kind of outcome that can linger beyond the final buzzer. One defeat does not define a season, particularly so early in the schedule. Still, the Warriors will need to address the breakdowns that allowed Memphis to turn a seemingly comfortable position into a road victory.

articles.title: LeBron James’ status puts the 76ers’ perfect start in question before Bucks showdown
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia has listed James as questionable for Saturday night with low back/sciatica management
articles.summary: Philadelphia has listed James as questionable for Saturday night with low back/sciatica management
articles.body:
L eBron James ’ first home game as a 76er ended with a 29-point comeback and a double-double. Now, just two days later, his status is suddenly uncertain: Philadelphia listed him as questionable for Saturday’s matchup with Milwaukee.

The official NBA injury report cites low back/sciatica management. That designation does not rule James out; his status could still change before tipoff. The Bucks visit Philadelphia at 7:30 p.m. ET, with the 76ers trying to protect their unbeaten start.

LeBron James’ availability could reshape a busy weekend for Philadelphia

The timing makes the update especially significant. Saturday is Philadelphia’s third game in five days and the first night of a back-to-back, with Detroit visiting Sunday. Joel Embiid has said he will play in only one of the two weekend games, though it remains unclear which one. That leaves the 76ers managing the workload of both stars as the schedule tightens.

James, 41, is in his record 24th NBA season and his first with Philadelphia. He had 17 points and 10 rebounds Thursday, helping the 76ers recover from a 29-point deficit to beat Cleveland, 114-106. It was the biggest comeback in franchise history during the play-by-play era and the largest comeback win of James’ career.

That rally capped an emotional home debut for James, who said the night was “everything I dreamed of and more.” Tyrese Maxey led Philadelphia with 32 points, Embiid added 24, and Jaylen Brown scored 21 . The win put the 76ers at 2-0 after they also came from behind to beat the Knicks in their season opener.

If James sits, Maxey may need to take on an even larger role. He has scored 28 and 32 points through the first two games, while Philadelphia tries to extend its winning start. Embiid’s availability remains a separate question because of his plan to play only once this weekend.

Milwaukee arrives looking for its first win after losses to Washington and Chicago. The Bucks are also playing the second night of a back-to-back, setting up a demanding test for both teams. For Philadelphia, the immediate question is whether James will be available to help the 76ers keep their perfect start alive.

articles.title: Luka Doncic’s handshake with Jarred Vanderbilt and Austin Reaves looks impossible at full speed
articles.summary: At full speed, Luka Doncic’s handshake with Jarred Vanderbilt and Austin Reaves looks like a blur. The three Lakers move through a quick sequence of taps and gestures that is hard to follow on the first watch.
articles.body:
At full speed, Luka Doncic’s handshake with Jarred Vanderbilt and Austin Reaves looks like a blur. The three Lakers move through a quick sequence of taps and gestures that is hard to follow on the first watch.

Slow it down, though, and every detail comes into focus. Luka, Vando and Austin know exactly when to move, turning a quick greeting into a smooth routine that feels like their own.

There’s a playful confidence in the way Luka leads the sequence, while the other two match him beat for beat. It’s a small moment, but one that shows how comfortable they’ve become around each other.

That kind of chemistry can grow one shared moment at a time. And after the Lakers’ win over the Clippers, this handshake is a fun glimpse of the connection taking shape between them.

articles.title: Something is changing: Stephen A. Smith comes to LeBron James’ defense following Donald Trump’s attack: "He is one of the greatest"
articles.standfirst: LeBron James gets support from Stephen A. Smith after Trump demands an apology
articles.summary: LeBron James gets support from Stephen A. Smith after Trump demands an apology
articles.body:
Stephen A. Smith has defended LeBron James after President Donald Trump condemned the Philadelphia 76ers star over his movements during the national anthem, arguing that one moment shouldn't overshadow a career.

Speaking on his YouTube channel, Smith praised James as one of the greatest champions and role models in American sports history.

He rejected the suggestion that the 41-year-old should be branded unpatriotic because footage showed him appearing to mimic a golf swing and basketball shot before Philadelphia's season opener against the New York Knicks.

“LeBron James as a role model, as a champion, is one of the greatest and belongs on the Mount Rushmore of those categories in American, if not world history,” said Smith.

“That’s how phenomenal he has been. He does not deserve to be viewed as some unpatriotic individual. Not at all.”

Trump shared the clip on social media and called James a “TOTAL DISGRACE,” demanding an apology to American military personnel who died serving the country. He revisited the criticism at a rally in Iowa, describing the incident as a scandal.

“I’m not here to tell you that it was a good look what LeBron did,” added Smith .

“I’m here to tell you that his history of professionalism, of decorum, and of handling himself like a role model should take precedence over one moment in which he was listening to the national anthem and feigning a golf swing. He deserves better than that from us.”

Smith questions the political purpose behind the criticism

The sports personality suggested Trump's attack may have a political purpose as Republicans approach the midterm elections.

Smith argued that targeting James could rally supporters, comparing the episode with former NFL quarterback Colin Kaepernick , who knelt during the anthem to protest racial injustice and police brutality.

Trump framed his objection as a matter of respect for the flag and those who served the United States. James and Trump have exchanged criticism for years, with James speaking about social issues and the role prominent athletes can play beyond their sport.

James responded briefly on Thursday after Philadelphia overturned a 29-point deficit to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106 in his home debut. He scored 17 points and collected 10 rebounds before dismissing the uproar as “a slow news day at the office.”

"It's a slow news day at the office, you know," James said. "Slow news day in the office."

The comeback was the largest of his career, giving the 76ers another reason to focus on basketball rather than the headlines.

Coach Nick Nurse echoed that approach, describing the presidential comments as outside noise. Philadelphia has opened the season 2-0, and the team appears intent on keeping attention on its performances instead of getting drawn into a political dispute.

"I think that goes right in with other outside noise we've already had," Nurse said. "I keep saying the same thing. All I really care about is getting to the practice floor, getting them in the film room, getting them to the game floor. The focus that they've had and the intent and all the stuff like that has been outstanding."

articles.title: Stephen Curry’s shocking misses came when the Warriors needed him most and he opened up afterward
articles.standfirst: Golden State let a 12-point fourth-quarter
articles.summary: Golden State let a 12-point fourth-quarter
articles.body:
One shot clips the rim. Another bounces away. Stephen Curry keeps trying from different spots, but the ball will not go in. The sequence is hard to watch precisely because Curry is usually the player Golden State trusts to make those shots when a game is on the line.

The misses came during a stunning collapse against Memphis. The Warriors were ahead by 12 with 3:47 remaining, then went scoreless from the field the rest of the way as the Grizzlies closed the game on a 17-0 run and escaped with a 111-108 victory.

Stephen Curry’s cold finish captured the Warriors’ late collapse

Curry finished with 24 points, but his shooting line told a different story: 5-for-15 from the field and 3-for-10 from three-point range. In the crunch-time clip, he goes 0-for-4, unable to turn any of those chances into the basket Golden State desperately needed.

The clip shows why the stretch felt so unusual. Curry tries from beyond the arc, pulls up from midrange and attacks toward the basket. The attempts do not look identical, but they end the same way: no points, no momentum, and no relief for a Warriors team watching its cushion shrink.

Still, the loss cannot be pinned on Curry alone. Golden State missed its final nine shots as a team, while Memphis found a way to score and take control. Ty Jerome led the Grizzlies with 28 points, and rookie Cameron Boozer added 25 as the comeback gathered speed.

With the game tied late, Boozer’s jumper gave Memphis a 108-106 lead with 20.1 seconds remaining. A costly offensive foul by Draymond Green, followed by a technical foul on coach Steve Kerr, made Golden State’s comeback attempt even harder. The Warriors had gone from controlling the game to chasing it in a matter of minutes.

Curry did not blame one player or one possession afterward. He acknowledged how painful it was to lose after the Warriors had put themselves in position to win. “There’s losses and then there’s ways that you lose like tonight that kind of sting a little bit more,” he said.

The Golden State Warriors will try to bounce back Saturday night against the Phoenix Suns, but Stephen Curry may not be on the floor. Golden State is playing the second game of a back-to-back and has started the season 0-2. After the loss to Memphis, Curry said he would “probably not” play in Phoenix, adding that he would talk with the team’s staff before a final decision.

Curry did not blame one player or one possession afterward. He acknowledged how painful it was to lose after the Warriors had put themselves in position to win. “There’s losses and then there’s ways that you lose like tonight that kind of sting a little bit more,” he said.

The Golden State Warriors will try to bounce back Saturday night against the Phoenix Suns, but Stephen Curry may not be on the floor. Golden State is playing the second game of a back-to-back and has started the season 0-2. After the loss to Memphis, Curry said he would “probably not” play in Phoenix, adding that he would talk with the team’s staff before a final decision.

articles.title: Austin Reaves backs off as Isaiah Jackson appears to travel: “No traveling in the NBA anymore?”
articles.summary: Isaiah Jackson drives toward the basket, but his footwork quickly becomes the story. As he appears to take several steps with the ball, Austin Reaves moves out of his way rather than risk making contact and drawing a foul.
articles.body:
Isaiah Jackson drives toward the basket, but his footwork quickly becomes the story. As he appears to take several steps with the ball, Austin Reaves moves out of his way rather than risk making contact and drawing a foul.

The slow-motion replay makes the sequence even harder to ignore: Jackson keeps moving toward the rim, Reaves pulls back, and the whistle never comes.

That’s the moment behind the sarcastic reaction: “No such thing as traveling in the NBA anymore.” The rule still exists, of course, but viewers are left wondering how Jackson’s steps went uncalled.

The play came during the Lakers’ 125–117 win over the Clippers. Jackson’s apparent travel and Reaves’ decision to avoid the foul turned one brief possession into a clip fans wanted to watch again.

articles.title: Jokic approaches 200 triple-doubles and lashes out at his fans: "They are no longer welcome"
articles.standfirst: Jamal Murray (42 points) and the center (35+15+10) lead the Nuggets' overtime win, after they trailed by as many as 23 amid boos from their own crowd
articles.summary: Jamal Murray (42 points) and the center (35+15+10) lead the Nuggets' overtime win, after they trailed by as many as 23 amid boos from their own crowd
articles.body:
The Nuggets' home opener was as turbulent as it gets. The home team found themselves trailing the Pelicans by 23 points (30-53) amid boos from their own fans. Then came a great comeback in the second half, an overtime victory, and Nikola Jokic's criticism of those who booed the team .

"They booed us in our first home game, and I think those fans no longer have any reason to come . If they follow us, they know we never give up and that we have come back from much worse situations. So, if you ask me, they are no longer welcome" , said the Serbian center, who finished with 35 points, eight of them in overtime, 15 rebounds and 10 assists . It was his 199th triple-double of his NBA career, which now leaves him just 10 short of Russell Westbrook's record . If there are no setbacks, he will break it this season.

The other architect of the feat was Jamal Murray, who scored 42 points . And the rookie Trevon Brazile, who scored seven of his 17 points in overtime , also played an important role, including a key three-pointer that put the Nuggets up by four points (133-129) with 1:25 remaining.

Jokic could not find an explanation for his team's poor first half. "Simply, nothing goes right for you. They make shots and you don't. There was bad energy and you need a couple of minutes to be able to get out of that" , the center analyzed. The Pelicans shot 65.9% from the field in the first half, which reflects quite badly on the home defense. At halftime they were leading 57-73 .

Murray and Jokic take charge

Coming out of the locker room, Jokic and Murray took control of the proceedings. They scored 22 of Denver's 32 points in the third quarter , but even so they were unable to cut the deficit by much. New Orleans, led by Trey Murphy (26) and Dejounte Murray (22) , were still 19 points ahead shortly after the start of the final period (91-110) .

A Murray three-pointer and an Aaron Gordon dunk put the Nuggets on their rival’s tail. The shooting guard, with two free throws with 16 seconds left, tied the game at 126, and Murphy lost the ball on the Pelicans’ final possession. In overtime, Jokic and Brazile scored all 15 of Denver’s points, and the Ball Arena crowd turned boos into ovations. The Serbian has not forgotten the former.

articles.title: Nikola Jokić and DeAndre Jordan share an emotional reunion before Denver’s historic comeback
articles.summary: The emotional reunion between Nikola Jokic and DeAndre Jordan offered a reminder that some of the strongest bonds in the NBA extend well beyond the time players spend together on the court. But when the ball went up on Denver’s home-opening night, friendship gave way to competition, and the Nuggets delivered a comeback for the ages. Denver overcame a 22-point second-half deficit to defeat the New Orleans Pelicans 141-135 in overtime, turning a night of reunions into a celebration of resilience. Jamal Murray scored 42 points, while Jokic recorded his first triple-double of the season in a game that required the Nuggets to rally in the fourth quarter before their starters took control in overtime.

articles.title: Jordyn Woods and Karl-Anthony Towns deliver chilling ‘Game of Thrones’ Halloween looks
articles.standfirst: The appearance offered another glimpse into the couple’s life together following their star-studded wedding in California
articles.summary: The appearance offered another glimpse into the couple’s life together following their star-studded wedding in California
articles.body:
K arl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods-Towns brought a little Westeros to New York City, trading their usual courtside glamour for chilling Game of Thrones Halloween costumes during their first spooky season as a married couple.

The New York Knicks star dressed as the Night King, while his wife transformed into a White Walker for a dramatic Halloween outing on Saturday night . The newlyweds were spotted dining outdoors at what appeared to be Sartiano’s in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood , with cameras capturing their elaborate looks.

Towns and Woods did not settle for ordinary Halloween outfits. Their icy costumes evoked the supernatural villains from HBO’s hit fantasy series, complete with the eerie aesthetic associated with the White Walkers and their fearsome leader.

The appearance offered another glimpse into the couple’s life together following their star-studded wedding in California earlier this year. And with Towns balancing the demands of another NBA season, the Halloween outing gave the Knicks center a chance to enjoy some time away from the basketball spotlight.

A spooky first Halloween as newlyweds

Towns and Woods married in August at a lavish ceremony in Malibu, California , overlooking the Pacific Ocean. The celebration brought together family, friends and a long list of celebrities and NBA personalities.

Among the guests were Towns’ Knicks teammates Jalen Brunson, Josh Hart, Miles McBride and OG Anunoby, along with their partners. Actor Ben Stiller, Kylie Jenner, Timothée Chalamet, Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber were also among the notable names in attendance.

The wedding even included a playful tribute to New York basketball. Guests received custom hoodies reading “Married in 5,” a nod to the Knicks’ championship hopes and their long wait for another NBA title.

For Towns and Woods, the Halloween costumes provided another opportunity to make a statement together. The pair’s Game of Thrones transformation was a dramatic departure from the polished fashion looks Woods often showcases and the basketball gear Towns wears on game nights.

Jordyn Woods brings championship style to New York

Woods has continued to build her own business and fashion profile alongside her relationship with Towns. She is the founder of Woods by Jordyn, and her latest accessory made an appearance during the Knicks’ season opener against the Philadelphia 76ers.

On that night, Woods debuted a limited-edition version of the Tux Clutch Mini in “Trophy Gold,” a design that complemented Towns’ celebration as he received his championship ring.

During the Knicks’ playoff run last season , Woods frequently carried an orange version of the bag, which became something of a good-luck charm as New York pursued the title. The team ultimately celebrated a Game 5 victory over the San Antonio Spurs in the NBA Finals , giving Towns and his teammates a championship to remember.

The gold accessory was a fitting choice for a season-opening celebration centered on the Knicks’ championship achievement. It also underscored Woods’ growing connection to the team’s fashion and lifestyle culture.

articles.title: Fans can't believe that the NBA's biggest cheapskate, LeBron James, is joining Savannah in a staggering $3 million purchase
articles.standfirst: LeBron James’ latest luxury purchase has fans questioning his taste in art
articles.summary: LeBron James’ latest luxury purchase has fans questioning his taste in art
articles.body:
LeBron James has sparked an online debate after revealing an expensive piece of art alongside his wife, Savannah James , in Vogue’s “Objects of Affection” video series.

The basketball superstar showed off Jean-Michel Basquiat’s painting Minor Success, reportedly bought for $3 million, leaving some fans questioning its price and artistic appeal.

During the video, James explained that Basquiat’s early work was shaped by limited resources, noting that the artist couldn’t always afford to put his creations on canvas.

“In some of his early work, he didn’t have the money or the resources to actually put some of his works on canvas,” said James .

“This is some of the first work where he started to use the crown and it resonated not only to me, it resonated to our family.”

Online reactions, however, were far less sentimental. Some commenters mocked the artwork’s appearance, comparing its expressive marks to something a child might create. Others questioned why wealthy celebrities spend millions on art that doesn’t appeal to everyone.

The reveal also revived James ’ reputation for being unusually frugal. Former teammate Dwyane Wade once jokingly labelled him the NBA’s “cheapest guy,” and fans have teased James over his reported reluctance to pay for mobile data.

Seeing him associated with a multimillion-dollar artwork made that reputation an easy target for jokes.

Why LeBron’s expensive artwork has fans talking

Basquiat is recognized as a major figure in contemporary art, celebrated for energetic compositions, symbolic imagery and his recurring crown motif.

His works have fetched substantial sums, though art remains subjective. The online criticism reflects that divide.

The purchase has also drawn attention because of James ’ enormous wealth and his reported move to the Philadelphia 76ers. While currently on an $8 million contract, his finances extend beyond basketball earnings, endorsements and business ventures.

Away from the art debate, James has also been in the spotlight for a family moment. His daughter Zhuri celebrated her 12th birthday courtside during Philadelphia’s October 22 game against Cleveland. A video shared by the NBA showed her smiling and waving in her father’s jersey.

James and Savannah are also parents to sons Bronny and Bryce . The NBA star has often spoken warmly about his children, and he’s said that seeing Zhuri smile can brighten his day.

He has also joked that she’s focused on volleyball, rather than adding another basketball player to the family.

articles.title: Devastating scene in Oklahoma City: Watch Jalen Williams suffer painful injury and leave court
articles.standfirst: The Thunder held on for the win, but the night ended with a major scare after Jalen Williams suffered a frightening leg injury.
articles.summary: The Thunder held on for the win, but the night ended with a major scare after Jalen Williams suffered a frightening leg injury.
articles.body:
Oklahoma City Thunder star Jalen Williams sparked major concern Sunday night after leaving the game against the Los Angeles Clippers with a frightening lower-leg injury.

The Thunder held on for a 108-101 win over the Clippers, but the victory was overshadowed by worry when Williams exited in the final minutes following a flagrant foul by Kris Dunn that left him in an awkward fall.

The team has not yet confirmed an official diagnosis, but the initial images raised alarm over the way the All-Star remained on the floor.

Jalen Williams’ concerning injury shakes the Thunder

After the contact, Oklahoma City’s medical staff quickly rushed onto the court to attend to Williams while his teammates watched the scene with visible concern.

The forward was carted off the floor, though he managed to give a thumbs-up to the crowd before leaving as a sign of reassurance amid the difficult moment.

Williams even flashed a positive gesture with both hands while being wheeled off the court, a moment that drew support from the fans.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander left shaken by the injury

After the game, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander spoke about the moment he saw his teammate go down and acknowledged the emotional impact it had on the team.

“I just feel bad for him. Nothing more than that,” Gilgeous-Alexander said.

Because the injury occurred so recently, there is still no definitive word on its severity. However, the appearance of the play left a heavy sense of concern among Thunder players and staff.

The situation is especially difficult for Williams, one of the franchise’s most important and beloved players. The All-Star has dealt with physical issues in recent years and was limited to just 33 games last season because of injuries.

When healthy, Williams has the talent to be considered an All-NBA caliber player, but he once again finds himself facing a significant physical challenge in his career.

Oklahoma City fans are hoping the injury is not as serious as it first appeared and that the team will soon have one of its key figures back on the floor.

articles.title: The 76ers have new plan to curb physical issues that could “take down” LeBron James
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia's championship ambitions have placed renewed importance on managing the physical demands facing James and Embiid
articles.summary: Philadelphia's championship ambitions have placed renewed importance on managing the physical demands facing James and Embiid
articles.body:
Winning the opening three games of an NBA season would usually encourage a coach to maintain a successful lineup, but Nick Nurse is taking a different approach with the Philadelphia 76ers .

Rather than pushing his biggest stars through every game, Philadelphia has begun managing the workloads of LeBron James and Joel Embiid , recognizing that their availability later in the season could matter considerably more than early victories.

James missed Saturday's 127-116 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks , sitting out the first game of a back-to-back because of lower back and sciatica management.

The decision raised questions about the condition of the 41-year-old, who is entering his 24th NBA season, although Nurse indicated that the absence was precautionary rather than the result of a fresh injury setback.

Philadelphia's decision followed discussions involving the team's medical department, front office and James ' representatives, with all parties working toward a schedule intended to preserve his fitness.

"I think I said after the game that the medical teams and LeBron's team and the front office group has been kind of working on that and it's where they landed," Nurse told reporters.

"Not sure where we are tomorrow yet. But that's where we are tonight, then we'll roll from there."

The 76ers coach also indicated that James hadn't reported fresh pain or discomfort, providing reassurance that the veteran's absence was part of a broader management plan.

That matters because James is attempting to maintain his performance deep into a career that has already spanned more than two decades.

With Philadelphia pursuing a championship, the organization appears determined to avoid placing unnecessary demands on him during the opening weeks.

Embiid's injury history adds another complication

James ' absence gave Embiid an opportunity to take greater responsibility against Milwaukee, and the former MVP responded with an outstanding all-around performance.

The center recorded 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, converting 12 of his 14 free throws as Philadelphia maintained its perfect start.

However, Embiid also faces restrictions because of his injury history, having failed to play more than 40 regular-season games in any season since 2022-23.

Despite expressing his desire to play on consecutive nights, the 76ers planned to manage his availability carefully.

"I actually want to play tomorrow, so can you guys put pressure on them?" Embiid joked with reporters.

"But it doesn't really matter. It's all about the season going well. So I guess the more time you can get to recover, the better, and then get used to it."

76ers putting long-term fitness ahead of early victories

Philadelphia 's approach reflects the challenge of building consistency around two established superstars whose health requires additional attention.

Resting James or Embiid can disrupt offensive chemistry, particularly when the team is still adapting to the arrival of its veteran forward.

However, the alternative could prove considerably more damaging if either player experiences an extended absence during the regular season.

Nurse must therefore balance competitive results with the physical demands facing his most important players.

The 76e r s have made an encouraging start, but their championship hopes are likely to depend less on maintaining an unbeaten record in October than ensuring James and Embiid remain healthy when the playoffs arrive.

"But it doesn't really matter. It's all about the season going well. So I guess the more time you can get to recover, the better, and then get used to it."
76ers putting long-term fitness ahead of early victories
Philadelphia 's approach reflects the challenge of building consistency around two established superstars whose health requires additional attention.
Resting James or Embiid can disrupt offensive chemistry, particularly when the team is still adapting to the arrival of its veteran forward.
However, the alternative could prove considerably more damaging if either player experiences an extended absence during the regular season.
Nurse must therefore balance competitive results with the physical demands facing his most important players.

The 76e r s have made an encouraging start, but their championship hopes are likely to depend less on maintaining an unbeaten record in October than ensuring James and Embiid remain healthy when the playoffs arrive.

articles.title: A’ja Wilson doesn’t hide her reaction as the Miami Heat struggle through a disastrous start to the season
articles.standfirst: The WNBA star was in attendance for Miami’s third straight loss, as another game raised questions about the team’s early-season struggles.
articles.summary: The WNBA star was in attendance for Miami’s third straight loss, as another game raised questions about the team’s early-season struggles.
articles.body:
T he Miami Heat haven’t gotten off to the start they were hoping for . Their first two losses of the 2026-27 season left the team needing to respond quickly to prevent the poor results from defining its opening weeks.

With that goal in mind, Miami visited the Charlotte Hornets on Saturday, October 24 , looking for its first win. However, things didn’t go as planned.

The Heat erased a huge deficit but still couldn’t get the win

Charlotte built a 23-point lead, but Miami managed to fight its way back into the game . The Heat cut the deficit and eventually tied the score at 100, bringing the excitement back to the matchup and opening the door for a potential comeback in the closing minutes.

However, Charlotte delivered when it mattered most. A four-point play by Grayson Allen proved crucial for the Hornets, who held off Miami’s comeback attempt to secure a 115-110 victory .

Among the moments that stood out was A’ja Wilson’s reaction from the stands. Cameras caught the Las Vegas Aces star looking visibly frustrated as the Heat once again came up short . Her expression didn’t go unnoticed, drawing interest from fans, particularly given her relationship with Bam Adebayo, one of Miami’s key players .

The Miami Heat will get another chance against Dallas

The Heat will look to turn things around on Monday, October 26, when they visit the Dallas Mavericks in search of their first win of the season .

There’s also hope that A’ja Wilson can share a happier night with Adebayo, with a result that finally gives them both a reason to smile.

articles.title: Jaylen Brown vs. Jayson Tatum? The former Celtics teammates are fueling an unnecessary NBA feud
articles.standfirst: The drama began when Tatum said in an Instagram video that he was as surprised by Brown’s departure as everyone else
articles.summary: The drama began when Tatum said in an Instagram video that he was as surprised by Brown’s departure as everyone else
articles.body:
T he Boston Celtics and Philadelphia 76ers have barely started their new NBA campaigns, and Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum are already providing a reminder that sometimes the most entertaining basketball happens away from the court.

A blockbuster trade sending Brown from Boston to Philadelphia this summer would have generated plenty of discussion on its own. But the lingering questions about how the separation happened, combined with a social media emoji and a pair of pointed postgame comments, have turned the breakup of one of the NBA’s most successful partnerships into an unexpected early-season soap opera.

The best part? Both players insist there is no beef.

The drama began when Tatum said in an Instagram video that he was as surprised by Brown’s departure as everyone else. Jaylen responded with a cap emoji, the familiar social media symbol for calling someone a liar. That small gesture might have disappeared into the endless stream of NBA discourse under normal circumstances.

Instead, it became the starting point for an increasingly awkward public exchange between two players who spent years building a championship partnership in Boston. Tatum addressed the situation after the Celtics defeated the New York Knicks on Friday.

His response suggested that the online speculation had become more frustrating than entertaining for him. He said there was no beef between the two, expressed disappointment that the conversation had turned into drama and emphasized the accomplishments they shared in Boston. Tatum also indicated that better communication would help prevent misunderstandings like this from becoming public spectacles.

After Philadelphia defeated the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday, Brown agreed with Tatum o n one important point: There was no beef. But the rest of his answer did little to put the story to bed. “ Jayson comes from a wonderful family. We’ve accomplished some great things. He’s a hell of a basketball player. He’s got a great PR team,” Brown said.

Then came the line that ensured the exchange would continue circulating online. “There’s no beef but there might be a little lamb chops and gravy. He should stay ready at all times.” Brown repeated the lamb chops and gravy reference, apparently enjoying the phrase enough to give it another run.

Whether it was a calculated attempt to generate headlines or simply an off-the-cuff remark, the result was the same: A supposed non-feud between former teammates had another day of life. And what exactly does “stay ready at all times” mean?

That is part of the appeal. Brown's comments were just ambiguous enough to invite interpretation without providing a clear accusation. He could have been joking, taking a subtle shot at Tatum or simply enjoying the attention surrounding a relationship that has become a subject of fascination for NBA fans.

Two stars, two very different approaches

The contrast between Brown and Tatum is what makes this episode more compelling than an ordinary exchange of postgame sound bites. Tatum appeared to want the conversation to end. His response focused on the years they spent together, their accomplishments and the disappointment of watching a productive professional relationship become fodder for online speculation.

That history matters. Brown and Tatum were central figures in Boston's rise to championship contention , enduring playoff disappointments before helping the Celtics win the 2024 NBA championship. Whatever tensions may have existed behind the scenes, their partnership produced a title that will remain part of the franchise's history.

Brown, meanwhile, appears comfortable allowing the conversation to continue. His emoji and subsequent comments have given fans fresh reasons to debate what happened during the summer and whether the two stars see the circumstances of the trade differently.

There is an important distinction between what is known and what is being speculated about, however. Brown's emoji does not prove that Tatum was informed of the trade in advance, just as Tatum's statement that he was surprised does not independently establish precisely what Boston's front office communicated to him.

It is possible that the Celtics consulted Tatum before making such a significant move. It is also possible that the trade unfolded differently than either player's public comments have led fans to imagine. Without more information, the exact sequence of private conversations remains unclear.

articles.title: Lakers urged to trade Bronny James before it's too late
articles.standfirst: Bronny James remains in the spotlight as trade rumors grow, with some analysts urging the Lakers to move him before his value declines.
articles.summary: Bronny James remains in the spotlight as trade rumors grow, with some analysts urging the Lakers to move him before his value declines.
articles.body:
B ronny James began the 2026-27 season with a secured spot on the Los Angeles Laker s roster, but his future with the franchise is once again surrounded by uncertainty. After surviving the preseason cuts, the 21-year-old guard has been repeatedly linked to trade rumors due to his limited playing time at the start of the NBA season.

In recent weeks, several reports have indicated that various franchises still view Bronny as a project with potential, while the Lakers could use him as a trade chip to address one of their biggest weaknesses: the frontcourt.

Although James retains some market value, his quiet start to the campaign could accelerate discussions. The Los Angeles organization would be willing to listen to offers if it means adding a power forward or center to strengthen a roster with championship aspirations.

So far, Bronny has played just seven minutes across the first three games of the season and has scored only two points.

Bronny James emerges as a possible trade piece

Before Dalton Knecht became the final player cut from the roster, there was a chance that Bronny James would be the one sacrificed. However, the Lakers decided to keep LeBron James ’ son, a decision that continues to generate mixed opinions.

“If I were the Lakers, I’d be trying to trade Bronny right now to some owner who wants to sell some jerseys. I’d rather keep Knecht on the books as possible trade salary than cut him and deal with dead money. The Lakers don’t really need the James brand like other teams do,” Sam Quinn of CBS Sports wrote in a post on X.

The analyst also questioned the young guard’s development.

“Just hasn’t reached the point of offensive viability through two years, and the defensive threshold is just so freaking high at that size that if he’s never gonna make shots, he basically has to be a Jamal Shead-level pest to even justify a roster spot and he isn’t, ” Quinn added.

With Dalton Knecht now with the New York Knicks , Bronny appears as one of Los Angeles’ most movable assets heading into the trade deadline.

Along the same lines, Tyler Watts believes the Lakers’ priority should be strengthening the roster, even if that means moving on from the young guard.

“The Los Angeles Lakers should still be looking to plug holes and should have no qualms about moving on from Bronny James.”

The big dilemma for the franchise is that, while several teams continue to see potential in Bronny, increasing his trade value would require giving him more minutes — something difficult to justify on a team looking to compete and with more established players ahead of him in the rotation.

Bronny still can’t find a place in the rotation

In the first three games of the season,Bronny still can’t find a place in the rotation has only seen action in one.

He played seven minutes in the season-opening win over the Bronny still can’t find a place in the rotation, where he scored two points on 1-of-1 shooting, while also recording two personal fouls and one turnover.

Since then, he has not returned to the court in the victories against the Los Angeles Clippers and Utah Jazz . The return of backup point guard Collin Sexton has also reduced opportunities for players at the end of the bench, including Jaden Hardy .

The statistics also fail to show significant growth compared to his first two seasons. As a rookie he averaged 2.3 points, 0.7 rebounds and 0.8 assists in 27 games, while last year he posted 2.9 points, 0.5 rebounds and 1.2 assists in 42 contests.

For now, Bronny James continues without establishing himself as an important piece in the Lakers’ basketball project — a situation that only fuels speculation about a possible trade as the transfer market deadline approaches.

articles.title: Paul Pierce's financial drama: the former NBA player who earned nearly $200 million says he is “drowning”
articles.standfirst: The Boston Celtics legend told a court that his income plummeted after he stopped receiving payments from Fox Sports and that he is now having difficulty meeting his financial obligations.
articles.summary: The Boston Celtics legend told a court that his income plummeted after he stopped receiving payments from Fox Sports and that he is now having difficulty meeting his financial obligations.
articles.body:
Paul Pierce is going through a complicated financial situation, at least according to the version he presented to a court amid his child support dispute. The former Boston Celtics player claims he is “financially drowning” after he stopped receiving payments from Fox Sports and while trying to meet his monthly obligations.

According to court documents, Pierce received his last payment from Fox Sports in August. The former player noted that his income had previously averaged around $119,000 per month, while in the last month he earned approximately $23,000 from stakes in other businesses.

The expenses complicating Pierce's finances

Pierce stated that he currently pays around $20,000 a month in spousal support and that his personal and family expenses total about $48,000 per month. These include about $8,000 in childcare, $5,000 in food, $7,000 in restaurants, $3,200 in utilities, $1,000 in clothing, and $3,500 in entertainment.

He also claimed to have about $300,000 in cash and properties valued at approximately $3 million .

The situation is unfolding amid his legal dispute with Princess Santiago , the mother of his son King Rafael Santiago Pierce. Santiago has requested another $40,000 in legal fees and $10,000 for a forensic accountant to review the former player's finances.

Pierce has already been ordered to pay $8,508 per month in temporary child support for his son, in addition to $100,000 for Santiago's legal fees. The support payment may be reviewed by the court as the proceedings move forward.

According to the former NBA player, the current figures contrast with the income Pierce accumulated during his 19 seasons in the NBA . The legal dispute has brought to light that the former player earned approximately $200 million in salary during his professional career.

Pierce, however, maintains that his current financial situation is very different from what it was during his years as a player. In documents filed earlier, he reported average income of about $128,000 per month in 2025 and approximately $165,000 per month during the first half of 2026. A significant portion of that income was related to Fox Sports.

The former player had previously warned that his payments linked to Fox Sports would end during this period and that this would mean a considerable reduction in his income.

Now, with those payments already over, Pierce argues before the court that he is having difficulty maintaining the level of financial obligations he faces. His financial situation has thus become one of the main points of dispute in the legal proceedings with Santiago.
